hf.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
hf.abstract: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.
hf.titleZh: 任意时间，任意空间:面向智能体视频生成的世界状态中心框架
hf.summaryZh: 长篇智能体视频生成要求非连续请求的镜头在空间与时间上保持一致，而仅在镜头间传递提示或近期帧，既无法提供重访场景所需的共享空间参照，也无法按时间索引重放早前事件。ATAS 将剧本编译为带显式地点、机位与事件时间引用的镜头请求，生成前从登记静态几何的场景记忆与按场景、事件、时间索引的动态事件记忆中检索证据，生成后重建并登记片段，仅在复核与状态检查通过时更新记忆，影片交付不依赖记忆准入。在四种视频生成器上，ATAS 提升全部跨镜头一致性指标并取得最高综合分，在目标图像空间重访上优于对比智能体与 3D 引导方法，并在六项人工评分中均列第一。
hf.reason: 视频生成为低分方向，仅智能体记忆机制略有擦边

hf.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
hf.abstract: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.
hf.titleZh: Player-1:从合成经验中学习玩游戏
hf.summaryZh: 针对游戏智能体依赖覆盖有限的大规模示范、缺少可扩展交互训练环境的问题，Player-1 扩展了 computer-use 动作空间(相对指针移动、持续输入、复合动作)，先在 6,044 条带指令与视觉推理的游戏轨迹上做监督初始化，再基于 16 个合成 2D/3D 环境 Player-1-Gym 与程序化可验证奖励做 PPO 多环境强化学习。Player-1-9B 与 Player-1-35B-A3B 在 MineDojo-300 上较各自 SFT 策略分别提升 27.8 与 17.7 个百分点，9B 成功率 38.33%，而最强基线仅 12.63%,ViZDoom-10 与 GameWorld 上同样有增益。分析显示更广的合成环境覆盖带来更好迁移，RL 中复合动作的使用比例上升。
hf.reason: Agentic RL 加自建合成环境与可验证奖励，直接命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
hf.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) by routing domain-specific data to specialized teachers, integrating their capabilities through dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, domain routing only distinguishes the supervision sources for different domains; updates from all domains still act on shared parameters. When teachers differ substantially in response style and domain expertise, supervision that is effective in isolation may still lead to persistent gradient conflicts and capability degradation during joint optimization. To address this challenge, we propose Cross-Teacher Guarding for MOPD (Road MOPD), which introduces non-routed teachers as auxiliary cross-domain critics on the same student trajectories and coordinates multi-teacher supervision through token-level credit assignment and gradient updates. Specifically, cross-teacher-guided credit assignment uses teacher agreement to strengthen token-level corrections jointly supported by the teachers and attenuate conflicting signals; preventive multi-teacher gradient projection uses auxiliary gradients from the same trajectories to constrain potentially conflicting updates and adaptively controls projection strength to retain target-domain learning signals. In experiments, Road MOPD mitigates degradation in the disadvantaged domain, gains over 5 percentage points under high conflict, and improves overall performance in low-conflict and three-domain settings.
hf.titleZh: 超越领域路由监督：面向多教师在线策略蒸馏的跨教师守护
hf.summaryZh: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）把不同领域数据路由给各自专家教师，但所有领域的更新仍作用于共享参数，当教师风格与专长差异大时会产生持续梯度冲突与能力退化。为此提出 Road MOPD：让非路由教师充当同一学生轨迹上的跨域批评者，一方面用教师一致性做 token 级信用分配，强化被多教师共同支持的修正、削弱冲突信号，另一方面用同轨迹的辅助梯度做预防性多教师梯度投影并自适应控制投影强度，以保留目标域学习信号。实验中该方法缓解了劣势领域的退化，在高冲突设置下提升超过 5 个百分点，并在低冲突与三教师场景下改善整体性能。
hf.reason: 在线策略蒸馏的直接改进，命中后训练与蒸馏方向

hf.title: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents
hf.abstract: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. We score each test case using four observable channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output; positive controls rule out vacuous passes. Across nineteen frontier models, each evaluated with three independent builds on 328 test cases, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. Even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and failures cluster around how cross-cutting functionality is split across modules. To our knowledge, Doc2Harness provides the first deterministic benchmark for measuring long-horizon harness engineering.
hf.titleZh: Doc2Harness:在编码智能体的长时程harness工程上评测LLM
hf.summaryZh: 现有benchmark都在固定harness下测下游成功率，harness工程本身未被评测。Doc2Harness分两阶段:先让build模型在固定builder harness内，凭接口契约骨架与汇总十二个前沿harness行为的开发文档，构造候选harness;再让冻结的候选harness逐用例隔离运行，由脚本化mock model驱动，并从模型请求、磁盘文件、退出码与命令输出四个通道打分，配正对照排除空过。19个前沿模型各三次构建、328个用例上，最高通过率53.05%，最弱27.44%，最强模型仍失败近半。
hf.reason: 首个harness工程基准，直击coding agent脚手架方向

hf.title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. Beyond final task performance, we examine training progress, stability, and measured computational cost. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, gains over GRPO remain limited in scope, with no method consistently outperforming it across settings. Second, strong final performance can mask unstable training. Third, additional training cost does not consistently translate into better performance. We establish this benchmark to support fair, comprehensive comparison and guide future research toward reliable and cost-effective improvements in agent training. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/Self-Distillation-AgentRL/
hf.titleZh: 更多的自蒸馏方法，更好的 Agent?对 Agentic RL 中自蒸馏的现实检验
hf.summaryZh: 针对 Agentic RL 中自蒸馏方法层出不穷却缺少公平对比的问题，在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA 与 WebShop 四个环境、三种模型规模上，把十种代表性方法与 GRPO 逐一对照，共完成 132 次训练、累计 12124.4 H800 GPU 小时，并对基座与全部十一种方法做八个 rollout 种子的重复评测，同时记录训练进程、稳定性与实测算力开销。结果显示:相对 GRPO 的收益范围有限，没有方法能在所有设置下稳定胜出;最终性能好可能掩盖训练不稳定;额外算力并不必然转化为更好表现。该基准为 Agent 训练方法的公平比较提供了统一口径。
hf.reason: Agentic RL 自蒸馏十种方法的系统性实测对比，直击 Agent 与后训练方向

hf.title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
hf.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. The resulting output, including the critique as privileged information, is scored by the teacher while the student uses the revision without the critique for training. On two Qwen3 students and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CriticOPD improves OPD, with the largest gains on competition problems.
hf.titleZh: 通过批判引导的在线策略蒸馏恢复可靠监督
hf.summaryZh: 在线策略蒸馏(OPD)用教师模型对学生自身 rollout 做 token 级监督，其隐含前提是教师能从学生写出的任意前缀回到正确答案，即可恢复性(recoverability);实验显示该性质在错误 rollout 上并不成立——教师会顺着学生的错误继续推理，尽管它其实能识别出错误。CriticOPD 把这种错误识别能力转化为监督信号:教师先对错误解答给出批判，学生据此重写答案，含批判的完整输出由教师打分，而学生训练时只使用不含批判的修订版本，批判作为特权信息仅用于打分。在两个 Qwen3 学生模型与六个数学推理 benchmark 上，该方法稳定优于原始 OPD，竞赛级题目上提升最大。
hf.reason: 在线策略蒸馏的可恢复性修正，批判作特权信息，直击后训练方向

hf.title: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
hf.abstract: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO's best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.
hf.titleZh: 多个正确答案，一个训练样本:为 LLM 推荐器去除 GRPO 中的回复者噪声
hf.summaryZh: 针对 RL 训练 LLM 推荐器时一个请求对应多条人类回复、奖励该对齐哪条的问题，现有 Rank-GRPO 每个样本只采样一条回复，优势函数约 85% 的方差来自“抽到了哪条回复”而非列表质量。ReMaRk 改为对每个请求的全部回复标题取并集、只打分一次并等概率采样请求，从而降低 RL 开销;在七个骨干与三个数据集上，用 25%–53% 的步数即达到每回复 RL 2000 步的验证召回，收敛后不显著落后，七个配对中有四个以更少 GPU 小时达到 Rank-GRPO 最佳。该奖励在每人约百人作答的 ProtoQA 上同样有效，提示多有效人类答案场景下应联合奖励。
hf.reason: GRPO 奖励聚合机制改进，直击后训练方向且具跨任务迁移性

hf.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
hf.abstract: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.
hf.titleZh: Cortex:将上下文整合进参数化记忆
hf.summaryZh: 解决上下文移除后性能增益随之丢失的问题，把记忆巩固形式化为将上下文增益内化进参数、同时保留非目标能力，统一了上下文指定的知识编辑、技能学习与行为引导。Cortex 生成前瞻性查询以预判上下文的潜在用法，再将上下文条件下的输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩或结构化 FFN 更新。在 4B–120B 的稠密与 MoE、纯文本与多模态骨干上，多数设置下位于巩固—保留帕累托前沿;14B 模型连续 50 次事实编辑后恢复 88.9% 的上下文增益，并保留 99.8% 的原始非目标性能。
hf.reason: 上下文内化进参数权重，方法新颖且实验覆盖 4B–120B

hf.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
hf.abstract: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. Prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. To probe the contributions of different loop visits, we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice, observing a smaller scale in the first visit. Fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance, whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. This asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. We propose LatentLoop, which compresses the first visit's sequence, retains full resolution in the second, and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. We further learn how strongly the first visit updates the full sequence, and share MoE weights across visits while using separate attention parameters to accommodate their different sequence resolutions. Across 15 configurations spanning 1.3B--7B parameters, with the largest budget exceeding 10^{21} FLOPs, LatentLoop consistently lowers validation NLL. At a fitted NLL of 1.988, predicted compute savings are 19.0\% and 7.9\% relative to vanilla MoE and the looped baseline. It also improves average scores on nine benchmarks at all sizes in 0-shot and 5-shot settings. These results suggest asymmetric compute allocation is a promising direction for looped MoE models.
hf.titleZh: LatentLoop：以非对称计算分配扩展循环 MoE 模型
hf.summaryZh: 循环 MoE 让同一组参数被多次访问，但各次访问的作用并不相同。作者在共享块被访问两次的模型中学习独立残差系数，发现第一次访问的尺度明显更小，且人为缩小第一次访问的尺度可保持或提升性能，缩小第二次则相反。据此提出 LatentLoop：压缩第一次访问的序列长度、第二次保持全分辨率，把省下的算力用于扩大隐藏维度，并学习第一次访问对全序列的更新强度，跨访问共享 MoE 权重、注意力参数各自独立以适配不同序列分辨率。在 1.3B–7B 共 15 组配置（最大预算超 10^21 FLOPs）上验证 NLL 一致下降，拟合 NLL 为 1.988 时相对原版 MoE 与循环基线分别预测节省 19.0% 与 7.9% 算力，九项基准的 0-shot 与 5-shot 平均分也全面提升。
hf.reason: 循环 MoE 架构与非对称算力分配，命中预训练架构方向

hf.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
hf.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.
hf.titleZh: SwarmRSI:通过进化式科学智能体集群实现递归自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 科学智能体的递归自我改进(RSI)依赖实验经验提升研究能力，但实验失败时难以区分是假设有误还是实现有错，整体程序分数也会掩盖可被其他智能体复用的组件。SwarmRSI 提出反馈引导的集群变异，利用其他智能体的实验反馈同时修正假设与实现;并提出互补集群重组，跨智能体复用保留的假设与互补程序组件，使部分结果支撑新研究;二者组成递归集群进化闭环，以新证据驱动后续研究。在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 与 MLE-Bench Lite 上取得 SOTA，积累的研究经验还能提升留出任务表现，并有生物学家复现其程序用于后续分析。
hf.reason: 科学智能体集群+递归自我改进，直击 Agent 与自进化方向

hf.title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
hf.abstract: Distilling capable language-model agents into smaller models requires aligning the student's behavior with the teacher's. This raises a fundamental question: at which states and at what granularity should this alignment be performed? Offline imitation provides dense but token-specific supervision and can suffer from state-distribution mismatch. Token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this mismatch but typically requires teacher token probabilities and compatible tokenization. We argue that semantic actions provide a natural unit of supervision for agent distillation. We introduce ActionOPD, an action-level on-policy distillation method motivated by maximizing expected teacher-action likelihood at student-encountered states. At each such state, ActionOPD samples actions from both the student and a black-box teacher, rewarding student actions according to their semantic agreement with the sampled teacher actions. Through policy optimization, ActionOPD aligns the student's action-level behavior with the teacher's decisions without requiring reproduction of teacher-written reasoning or access to teacher token probabilities. Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with two teachers on diverse, curated tool-use tasks yields average gains of 3.3-6.9 percentage points across four out-of-distribution benchmarks. ActionOPD scales favorably with student size and teacher capability, without requiring the teacher and student to share a model family or tokenizer. On τ^2-bench, ActionOPD achieves competitive performance against offline distillation and token-level OPD. We further explore Self-ActionOPD with a same-model teacher and privileged context. These results establish ActionOPD as a promising approach to agent distillation.
hf.titleZh: ActionOPD:蒸馏决策，而非 token
hf.summaryZh: 大模型agent蒸馏到小模型，核心是在哪些状态、以什么粒度对齐:离线模仿监督稠密但逐token，存在状态分布偏移;token级on-policy蒸馏缓解了偏移，却依赖teacher的token概率与相同分词器。ActionOPD改以语义动作为监督单元，在学生访问到的状态上采样学生与黑盒teacher的动作，按语义一致度奖励学生动作并做策略优化，无需复现teacher推理文本或访问其token概率。在工具使用任务上用两个teacher训练Qwen3-4B/8B，四个分布外基准平均提升3.3–6.9个百分点，可跨模型族与分词器，τ²-bench上与离线蒸馏、token级OPD相当，并支持同模型teacher加特权上下文的Self-ActionOPD。
hf.reason: action级on-policy蒸馏，黑盒teacher跨分词器，命中Agent蒸馏方向

hf.title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
hf.abstract: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.
hf.titleZh: 看见、维护与学习:多模态智能体记忆的演化
hf.summaryZh: 多模态智能体在长时程任务与终身学习场景中，难以从复杂异构数据里持续积累有效信息，关键在于缺乏跨会话保持连续、适应用户与环境变化、并能随经验自我调整的记忆机制。该综述提出两轴分析框架:Axis I 刻画记忆的形成与表示，涵盖模态嵌入、文本与结构化记录、潜在与参数化表示;Axis II 刻画记忆管理，区分 T1 静态记忆、T2 动态记忆与 T3 自演化记忆三层。据此归纳出可复用的设计模式与原则:在来源保真与抽象之间取平衡、维护时间有效性与溯源、让记忆使用落在可恢复证据上、并让记忆策略随时间演化，为多模态 Agent 记忆系统的设计提供路线图。
hf.reason: Agent 记忆综述，两轴框架直击长时程智能体记忆设计

hf.title: LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything
hf.abstract: We introduce LensErase, a general-purpose mask-based Erase Anything foundation model designed to cover a broad spectrum of real-world erase scenarios. LensErase supports diverse objects, visual text, watermarks, associated visual effects, multiple-object removal, and a wide range of object scales, aspect ratios, and image resolutions. First, to enable such broad coverage, we construct LensErase-100M, a large-scale dataset containing 101.07 million paired source-mask-target examples spanning diverse erase scenarios. Second, we pretrain LensErase from the text-to-image model Lens, adapting its strong generative prior to mask-based erasing. To efficiently incorporate the source image and erase mask, we propose Mask-Aware RoPE, a 3D rotary positional encoding that directly injects mask information into the source-image tokens without introducing a separate mask token sequence. Finally, we refine the model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with contract-guided, region-aware rewards, and apply TraceFusion at inference to preserve high-fidelity content outside the effective edit region. Across six public benchmarks and the proposed LensErase-Bench, LensErase achieves substantial improvements under both reference-based objective metrics and reference-free VLM evaluation. We hope LensErase can serve as a foundational model for erase-related applications and systems.
hf.titleZh: LensErase：可擦除一切的基础模型
hf.summaryZh: 面向真实场景中多样化的图像擦除需求（物体、视觉文字、水印、关联视觉特效、多目标移除，以及不同尺度、长宽比与分辨率），构建了包含 1.0107 亿组源图-掩码-目标三元组的 LensErase-100M 数据集，并从文生图模型 Lens 出发预训练通用掩码擦除基础模型。方法上提出 Mask-Aware RoPE，用 3D 旋转位置编码把掩码信息直接注入源图 token，省去独立的掩码 token 序列，再经监督微调与带契约引导、区域感知奖励的强化学习精修，推理时用 TraceFusion 保持有效编辑区域外的高保真内容。在六个公开基准与自建的 LensErase-Bench 上，参考型客观指标与无参考 VLM 评测均取得明显提升，面向图像擦除类应用与系统提供基础模型。
hf.reason: 图像擦除/编辑生成任务，属视觉生成低分方向

hf.title: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
hf.abstract: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this KV concentration and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose KV4-RL, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves 1.80times cumulative rollout speedup and 1.27times cumulative full-iteration speedup over BF16 rollout, reaching 1.97times rollout speedup over the final 50 iterations. Under a common BF16 evaluator, its final six-benchmark mean accuracy is within 0.5 percentage points of BF16-rollout training for both Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base.
hf.titleZh: KV4-RL:用INT4 KV缓存量化解锁更快的RLVR异步Rollout
hf.summaryZh: 异步rollout能缓解RLVR长尾生成时的算力空转，但持续并发会把上下文处理压缩进更少的decode步，使单步KV负载显著上升。该工作刻画了这一KV集中现象，发现同等负载下KV缓存量化的加速远高于仅权重量化与权重-激活量化，但INT4 KV会导致学习退化，即便使用token级截断重要性采样也难避免。为此提出KV4-RL:免校准INT4 KV量化，并对attention sink与近期上下文等有限位置做选择性INT8保护，在保住大部分加速的同时降低采样器失配。Qwen3-8B-Base上400步GRPO训练取得1.80倍rollout累计加速与1.27倍整轮加速，末50步rollout加速达1.97倍;统一BF16评测下，Qwen3-4B与8B的六基准平均精度与BF16 rollout训练的差距均在0.5个百分点以内。
hf.reason: RLVR异步rollout叠加INT4 KV量化，后训练与推理效率双命中

hf.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
hf.abstract: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.
hf.titleZh: 迈向智能体机器人:模型、数据、环境与执行框架
hf.summaryZh: 机器人智能体研究进展快但彼此割裂，尚缺乏把数据采集、模型训练、任务规划与真实执行串成完整系统的统一视角。综述先梳理从机器人策略到智能体系统的演进，涵盖 VLA 模型、世界模型与 world-action 模型，再将现有工作按模型、数据、环境、执行框架四个功能域划分为十七类，分别考察智能体如何塑造模型学习与决策、采集与整理机器人数据、构建世界与任务测试、组织可供机器人调用的能力。最后列出开放挑战与未来方向，为构建更可靠、更自适应的智能体机器人提供参考框架。
hf.reason: 机器人与具身智能方向，按画像一刀切归低分

hf.title: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
hf.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to automate complex computer-use workflows, yet existing benchmarks mostly assume consistent, cooperative environments. In contrast, real-world collaboration rarely runs on consistent information: peer or sub-agents frequently report outdated states, issue contradictory instructions, or compete over shared permissions and files, forcing agents to check others' outputs and verify ground truth in the environment. Evaluating such conflict resolution remains challenging: manual authoring cannot scale across complex systems, while unconstrained LLM generation produces narrative drift, answer leakage, and unsatisfiable rubrics. We introduce CLASHarness (Conflict-Loaded Agent Scenario Harness), a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer use, with a benchmark of 600 multi-round tasks. By combining hierarchical scenario planning with an eight-step verified micro-pipeline, CLASHarness pre-commits decisive visual facts before rendering and compiles hybrid code and semantic graders directly from executed reference trajectories, guaranteeing every task is solvable by construction. Evaluating 15 frontier models on CLASHarness reveals three core bottlenecks. First, when sub-agent outputs conflict with the environment, weaker models blindly follow misleading information, whereas stronger models inspect visual evidence to verify ground truth. Second, resolving conflicts is much harder than finding them: while agents can spot inconsistencies, actively fixing system state drops task success significantly. Third, coordination protocols remain a universal bottleneck: even frontier models fail over 58% of closing actions, often forgetting to release shared locks or hand off tasks. CLASHarness provides a scalable, verifiable foundation for building reliable multi-agent systems.
hf.titleZh: CLASHarness:通过可控且可验证的生成流水线评测计算机使用中的多智能体冲突
hf.summaryZh: 现有多智能体计算机使用基准大多假设环境信息一致且子智能体协作，而真实协作中子智能体常上报过时状态、发出矛盾指令或争夺共享权限与文件，使冲突消解能力难以评测。CLASHarness 以分层场景规划配合八步验证微流水线，在渲染前预提交决定性视觉事实，并从已执行的参考轨迹编译代码与语义混合评分器，生成 600 个多轮任务且保证任务可解。在 15 个前沿模型上的评测暴露三个瓶颈:弱模型盲从误导信息，强模型会核查视觉证据;发现冲突远比修复系统状态容易;协调协议是普遍短板，前沿模型在收尾动作上失败率超过 58%。该框架为构建可靠多智能体系统提供了可扩展、可验证的评测基础。
hf.reason: 多智能体冲突评测基准，生成流水线可控可验证，命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: RuleTrek: Benchmarking Agentic Rule Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly tackle complex real-world tasks in specialized domains. However, identifying and correctly applying domain-specific rules remains challenging when scenario information is distributed across multiple files. Existing rule-reasoning benchmarks typically represent scenarios using only a few factual statements, simplifying the identification and application of relevant rules. To address this gap, this paper introduces RuleTrek, a multi-domain benchmark for agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios. Its rule-grounded construction pipeline extracts structured rule graphs, generates and incrementally composes rule-specific sub-scenarios while ensuring consistency and solvability. To systematically evaluate agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios, RuleTrek assesses three capabilities in interactive workspaces: Rule Identification (RI), Rule Deduction (RD), and End-to-End Rule Reasoning (E2E). Experiments on 11 frontier LLMs show that the highest RI and RD scores are only 62.47\% and 60.43\%, respectively, while E2E scores range from 26.97\% to 55.29\%. These results demonstrate that current LLM agents face substantial challenges in rule reasoning over complex scenarios. We make our code and dataset publicly available at https://github.com/yuan247/RuleTrek{RuleTrek}.
hf.titleZh: RuleTrek:面向复杂场景的智能体规则推理基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有规则推理基准通常只用少量事实陈述描述场景，难以反映规则分散在多个文件、需要跨文件检索与组合的真实情形。RuleTrek 通过规则驱动的构建流水线抽取结构化规则图，并增量组合出规则专属子场景，保证一致性与可解性，在交互式工作区中评测规则识别、规则演绎与端到端规则推理三项能力。对 11 个前沿 LLM 的测试显示，规则识别与演绎最高分仅 62.47% 与 60.43%，端到端得分在 26.97%–55.29% 之间，表明当前智能体在复杂场景的规则推理上仍有明显短板。
hf.reason: Agent 规则推理基准，交互式评测设计扎实，属评测与 Agent 交叉方向

hf.title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
hf.abstract: Hybrid reasoning models such as the Qwen3 series switch between a THINK mode and a NO-THINK mode through a few chat-template tokens. A popular recipe trains such models with reinforcement learning in NO-THINK mode and reports improved reasoning performance. We provide evidence that much of this gain can be explained by thinking leakage: the gain comes largely from partially reactivating the reasoning abilities of the original model's THINK mode instead of learning enhanced reasoning behavior. We train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B with GRPO in NO-THINK mode. As accuracy improves, responses become longer and more reflective, are increasingly judged by the original model to resemble its own thinking, and the model's internal activations shift toward its THINK mode. We then investigate at the level of weights, activations, and attention heads: scaling the RL update further elicits THINK-mode behavior and approaches THINK-mode accuracy but does not exceed it; in Qwen3-8B, replacing a low-dimensional THINK-related activation subspace of the RL-trained model with its original-model value removes most of the RL gain, and the reverse exchange transfers a considerable fraction of the gain to the original model; and the RL-induced shift passes through the attention heads that read the empty think block. We further identify a possible mechanism in the GRPO training signal: responses favored by the advantage-weighted update are more THINK-like, and a gradient step computed from this signal moves the model toward its THINK state. Thus, gains in NO-THINK mode can largely reflect reactivation of reasoning abilities already present in the original model.
hf.titleZh: LLM 强化学习中的思维泄漏
hf.summaryZh: 在NO-THINK模式下用RL训练Qwen3等混合推理模型已被报告能提升推理表现，本文论证这部分增益主要来自思维泄漏，即重新激活原模型THINK模式已有的推理能力，而非学到更强的推理行为。作者用GRPO训练Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B，观察到准确率上升的同时回复变长、更像自身思考，内部激活也向THINK模式偏移。进一步在权重、激活与注意力头层面验证：加大RL更新量只能逼近而不超过THINK精度；在8B上把低维THINK相关激活子空间换回原模型值可抹掉大部分增益，反向替换则把相当部分增益转移给原模型，且偏移经由读取空think block的注意力头。该结果提示NO-THINK模式下的RL收益需要重新审视。
hf.reason: GRPO训练机理分析，直击后训练推理增益来源

hf.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
hf.abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
hf.titleZh: 混合推理 Agent(HybridAgents)
hf.summaryZh: 现代 LLM Agent 依赖文本推理并借文本调用工具，潜空间推理虽高效却缺乏原生工具访问与推理透明度。HybridAgent 在统一生成过程中动态切换两种模式:轻量级 HybridLink 负责文本与潜空间的无缝转换，连续工作记忆在多轮间保留无损混合上下文，潜空间思维因此可直接检视。配套的 HybridSFT 稳定工具集成的混合生成，HybridRL 学习何时潜空间思考、何时文本行动。在 3 个模型规模、11 个覆盖数学、科学、医学、搜索与 Agent 推理的基准上平均提升 10.4%,token 减少 35.5%–54.7%，推理加速 1.8–2.6 倍。
hf.reason: 潜空间推理与工具调用融合的 Agent 架构加配套后训练算法，直击 Agent 方向

hf.title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
hf.abstract: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.
hf.titleZh: HumanoidToolBench:从工具选择到移动执行的类人机器人工具使用基准
hf.summaryZh: 类人机器人要突破自身形体限制完成任务，必须选对工具并协调操作与移动，而现有基准无法在类人本体上联合评估这些能力。为此构建 HumanoidToolBench，涵盖 18 个任务、3 类场景、3 个执行层级与两种工具集模式，并配套 ToolBook 数据集，包含 3.1k 条在仿真环境与真实 Unitree G1 上采集的演示。在仿真中评测 7 个策略、真机上评测 3 个策略，结果显示工具选择与任务完成之间存在明显落差;对 GR00T N1.7 的针对性探测还发现其在未见工具上选择准确率下降，并会在无关指令下继续执行任务。
hf.reason: 类人机器人工具使用基准，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation
hf.abstract: Post-training is crucial for improving text-to-image models, yet existing pipelines typically rely on manually curated training data and fixed training distributions. We introduce APT (Agentic Post-Training), a fully automated framework that adaptively post-trains a base model according to its evolving capability profile. APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated.
hf.titleZh: APT:反馈驱动的智能体化后训练，用于文本到图像生成
hf.summaryZh: 文本到图像模型的后训练通常依赖人工筛选数据与固定训练分布，APT 把这一流程改为全自动闭环:三个 Agent 分别根据用户需求构建评测集、诊断模型自身的强项与失效模式、并生成分布自适应偏向薄弱能力的强化学习数据。反复的「评测—诊断—更新」让当前模型的行为决定下一轮训练任务，形成受递归自我改进启发的反馈回路;针对未指定评测场景的通用设定，还提供可生成广泛多样评测集的评测 harness。在多种基座模型、benchmark 与生成架构上的实验显示，该方法与模型、benchmark、架构无关且全程自动化。
hf.reason: Agentic RL 与自进化闭环可借鉴，但落在图像生成低分域

hf.title: Super-Resolution in The Right Latent Space: A Frozen Vision-Foundation Substrate
hf.abstract: In an image latent space, the embeddings of high-resolution, natural, and sharp images form a manifold. Degradation of high-resolution images pushes their embeddings off this manifold. Real-world super-resolution (SR) then becomes the task of mapping the degraded embedding back onto this manifold --- not anywhere on the manifold, but to the point that preserves what the input still carries, both its semantics and pixel details. Every published method implements this mapping in a reconstruction-oriented latent space or pixel space. We claim these spaces are the wrong substrates for SR. Low-resolution and degraded images are embedded far from the manifold, making the mapping difficult and expensive. The lack of semantic information in these substrates also makes it difficult to navigate to the faithful point on the manifold, causing severe hallucination when degradation is heavy. Thus, restoring in a suitable latent space is crucial to the SR task. We show that the latent space of 23 fused layers of a frozen DINOv3-L is one such space that makes the SR task easier. Degraded images are embedded near the manifold. Moreover, this substrate contains a hierarchy of information, from pixel record to degradation robust semantics, guiding the model to find the faithful point on the manifold. On this substrate, a 415M decoder is trained under reconstruction and adversarial objectives to map the degraded embeddings back and decode to pixel space in one pass. The resulting model, RAESR, attains the best fidelity--perception trade-off among state-of-the-art adversarial and diffusion-based restorers on RealSR, DRealSR, LSDIR and DIV2K-Val, at 37 ms per 512 by 512 image on a single H20 GPU. Swapping the substrate for a VAE latent under an identical recipe loses on every metric.
hf.titleZh: 在正确的潜空间中做超分辨率:一个冻结的视觉基础底座
hf.summaryZh: 把真实世界超分辨率重新表述为将退化图像嵌入映射回高分辨率清晰图像所在流形，且落到保留语义与像素细节的忠实点。退化嵌入在像素或 VAE 潜空间中远离流形且缺少语义，重度退化时幻觉严重;该工作改用冻结 DINOv3-L 的 23 层融合特征作底座，嵌入更贴近流形并含从像素记录到退化鲁棒语义的层级信息，其上训练 415M 解码器，以重建与对抗目标一次前向解码回像素。所得 RAESR 在 RealSR、DRealSR、LSDIR、DIV2K-Val 上取得优于对抗与扩散方法的最佳保真—感知权衡，512×512 单张在单块 H20 上耗时 37 ms，换用 VAE 潜空间则各项指标全面落后。
hf.reason: 图像超分属视觉恢复方向，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线几无交集

hf.title: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
hf.abstract: Emerging decision models such as JEV provide typed interfaces that map task instructions and observations directly to choices, judgments, and scores. As these models are increasingly used for automated decision-making, understanding their reliability under adversarial manipulation becomes critical. We introduce DecisionRobust, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the robustness of decision models across textual and visual inputs. Our benchmark covers practical decision-making scenarios and a diverse suite of attacks, including semantics-preserving text perturbations, image perturbations, and prompt injection in both modalities. We curate evaluation sets through external validity checks and cross-model candidate selection. We evaluate 30 model configurations on text tasks and 17 on vision tasks, including 24 and 12 held-out models, respectively, that are excluded from candidate selection. Our experiments reveal several key findings. First, attacks expose vulnerabilities beyond the models used for construction and selection, although optimized image perturbations transfer weakly to many targets even with multiple surrogates. Second, relative model robustness varies across tasks and attack types, and resistance to input perturbations does not necessarily imply resistance to prompt injection. Third, label-consistency checks substantially reduce measured attack success across text and image settings, highlighting the importance of validating apparent failures. The benchmark is available at https://yifan-lan.github.io/DecisionRobust/.
hf.titleZh: DecisionRobust：跨文本与视觉的 JEV 风格决策模型鲁棒性基准
hf.summaryZh: JEV 类决策模型通过类型化接口把任务指令与观测直接映射为选择、判断与分数，其在对抗操纵下的可靠性尚缺系统评估。DecisionRobust 覆盖文本与视觉两类输入，攻击套件包含语义保持的文本扰动、图像扰动以及两种模态下的 prompt injection，评测集经外部效度检查与跨模型候选筛选构建。实验评测了文本侧 30 个、视觉侧 17 个模型配置，其中分别有 24 与 12 个未参与候选筛选的留出模型；结果显示攻击能暴露构建与筛选模型之外的脆弱性，优化图像扰动的迁移性偏弱，模型鲁棒性排序随任务与攻击类型变化，且抗输入扰动并不等于抗 prompt injection，标签一致性检查会显著降低测得的攻击成功率。该基准为决策模型的鲁棒性评估与表面失败的校验提供了可复用的方法学框架。
hf.reason: 基准与评估方法学工作，含留出模型与失败校验，命中评测方向

hf.title: Share the Symbol, Not the Vector: Training-Free Fact Communication Across Language Models
hf.abstract: Multi-agent systems allow language models to solve tasks collaboratively by sharing complementary information. These systems typically communicate through text, while recent approaches also explore exchanging internal model states. However, sharing these states across architectures often requires learned translators or assumptions about model compatibility. We introduce SYNC (Symbol-Indexed Neural Communication), a word-indexed interface that connects heterogeneous models without fine-tuning or a learned translator. From descriptions only it can see, the sender selects words from a shared list and sends their indices for each object, without seeing the questions. The receiver writes the described facts into its hidden states using its own word directions, vectors fitted once from its activations. We test selective use by swapping one attribute between two objects and requiring correct answers about both changed and unchanged attributes before and after the swap, four answers in total. We choose an early write layer on four development receivers and then fix it. With three different senders and nine newer receivers from five families, four-answer success on new scenes reaches 72.0-98.3%, up to 96 percentage points above middle-layer writing, and the two largest receivers match plain text. A task-free probe predicted in advance which depths each new receiver can use (45 of 45 cases). Without retuning, messages listing every fact keep 89.6-100% success under new layouts, and sender messages reach 23.9-64.0% on a landmark task with multi-token symbols, below text but from 0% without a message. These results show that shared word indices and receiver-local directions can support selective fact use across model families without additional training.
hf.titleZh: 共享符号，而非向量:跨语言模型的免训练事实通信
hf.summaryZh: 多智能体协作多依赖文本传递，近期工作尝试共享内部隐状态，但跨架构共享常需训练翻译器或假设模型兼容。SYNC采用词索引接口:发送方仅凭自己能看到的描述，从共享词表选词并发送索引;接收方用自身激活一次性拟合的词方向向量，把事实写入隐藏状态，全程无需微调。在交换两个对象某一属性、需答对四个问题的选择性测试中，跨5个模型族、9个接收方的四答成功率达72.0–98.3%，较中间层写入最高提升96个百分点，最大两个接收方与纯文本持平;无任务探针提前预测各接收方可用深度(45/45)。表明共享词索引加接收方本地向量，无需额外训练即可跨模型族选择性使用事实。
hf.reason: 跨模型隐状态通信的免训练接口，属多智能体方向扎实工作

hf.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
hf.abstract: Professional agents increasingly work through command-line interfaces and multiple tools over shared workspaces containing files, messages, and business applications. These environments create safety risks that are difficult to capture with attacks placed at a single, known read location. We introduce APEX-Harm, a benchmark for evaluating prompt and script injection against long-horizon agents performing finance, consulting, and legal tasks in large workspaces. Each task contains 115 to 328 files, together with email, calendar, chat, document, spreadsheet, PDF, and code-execution tools exposed through MCP servers. The benchmark includes six attack categories covering static and dynamic injections, task-specific script replacement, and attacker-provided generic scripts, and evaluates attack success, exposure, and task performance. We evaluate 12 frontier models on 180 task instances per model. Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 have the lowest overall attack success rates (8% and 20%), while task-specific script replacement and attacker-provided generic script attacks remain substantially more effective, averaging 81-84% and 73% attack success, respectively. Gemini 3.8 Flash achieves the highest mean task score (0.877) while still exhibiting a 33% attack success rate. These results show that completing the requested task is not sufficient evidence of safe behavior: an agent can produce a correct deliverable while also performing an unauthorized action in the workspace.
hf.titleZh: APEX-Harm:评估共享专业工作空间中的 Agent 安全性
hf.summaryZh: 针对在共享工作空间中长程作业的专业 Agent，构建 APEX-Harm 基准:任务覆盖金融、咨询、法律，单任务含115–328个文件，并通过MCP服务器暴露邮件、日历、聊天、文档、表格、PDF与代码执行工具。基准设计六类攻击，涵盖静态与动态注入、任务特定脚本替换与攻击者提供的通用脚本，评测攻击成功率、暴露度与任务表现。在12个前沿模型、各180个任务实例上，Opus 5与Sonnet 5攻击成功率最低(8%与20%)，任务特定脚本替换与通用脚本攻击仍达81–84%与73%;Gemini 3.8 Flash任务得分最高(0.877)却有33%攻击成功率，说明完成任务并不等于行为安全。
hf.reason: Agent安全基准，长程工具调用与注入攻击评测，方向直接命中

hf.title: LabInstruct: Benchmarking Situated Instructional Video Generation for Lab Procedures
hf.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) aim to automate the full experimental loop, from scientific decision-making to physical execution. Ideally, AI-generated plans could be carried out directly by robotic systems, but reliable automation remains difficult in complex, open-world laboratory environments, where experiments often involve fine-grained manipulation, long-horizon procedures, and substantial variation across tasks and setups. Humans therefore remain an important execution interface between AI-generated plans and physical experiments, creating a need for clear and effective human-facing experimental guidance. Because laboratory procedures are inherently visual, spatial, and dynamic, video is particularly well suited to communicating apparatus configurations, manipulation actions, temporal dependencies, and state changes. Recent advances in video generation now make it possible to synthesize experimental demonstrations directly from an initial workspace image and a natural-language instruction. However, whether such models can reliably communicate real laboratory procedures has not been systematically studied. We introduce LabInstruct, a benchmark for situated instructional video generation in real laboratories. LabInstruct contains 204 tasks across 5 scientific disciplines, with real reference executions and structured annotations of objects, actions, contacts, and state transitions. Evaluating 8 frontier image-to-video models, we find that visually plausible generations frequently remain procedurally incorrect, revealing a substantial gap between visual realism and the reliability required for experimental instruction.
hf.titleZh: LabInstruct:面向实验室流程的场景化教学视频生成基准
hf.summaryZh: 自驱动实验室希望把 AI 生成的实验方案直接交给机器人执行，但在开放世界的真实实验室中，精细操作、长时序流程与任务间差异使可靠自动化依然困难，人类仍充当方案与物理实验之间的执行接口，需要清晰的人向实验指导。实验室流程本质上是视觉化、空间化且动态的，视频适合表达装置配置、操作动作、时间依赖与状态变化。LabInstruct 覆盖 5 个学科、204 个任务，提供真实参考执行视频以及对物体、动作、接触和状态转移的结构化标注。对 8 个前沿图生视频模型的评测显示，视觉上逼真的生成结果常常在流程上出错，暴露出视觉真实感与实验指导所需可靠性之间的明显差距。
hf.reason: 教学视频生成基准，主体落在低分视频生成方向

hf.title: τ-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
hf.abstract: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce τ-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to τ-Bench and τ-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, τ-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.
hf.titleZh: τ-Emotion-Bench:从真实用户情绪暴露 LLM Agent 的交互脆弱性
hf.summaryZh: 现有工具调用评测普遍假设用户始终合作且行为稳定，忽视了情绪波动对 agent 可靠性的影响。该工作提出 τ-Emotion-Bench，在保持任务目标不变的前提下，以情绪条件化的用户交互覆盖十个领域;配套的 Tracer 管线自动构造合规任务，并通过 agent—用户—环境交互框架采集轨迹，允许不满用户提前终止低效交互，从而过滤过度依赖用户的轨迹。两个用户模拟器上的实验显示，前沿模型平均任务成功率与一致性完成率之间仍有明显差距;Tracer 生成的监督在多个规模的 Qwen3 上稳定提升，可泛化到未见领域并迁移至 τ-Bench 与 τ-Trait。这种交互感知监督思路适用于工具调用 agent 的鲁棒性训练与 Agentic RL。
hf.reason: Agent 交互鲁棒性评测加数据合成管线，贴合 Agentic RL

hf.title: SkillMarker: A KGW-Based Watermarking Method for Agent Skill Ownership Verification
hf.abstract: Agent skills encode operational procedures and domain expertise as reusable knowledge assets, yet their distribution in plaintext exposes them to unauthorized copying and leakage. However, practical mechanisms for skill ownership verification and leakage tracing remain underdeveloped. Watermark embedding before distribution offers a potential solution, but structured, compact skill instructions impose stringent requirements for factual and procedural accuracy. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillMarker, a KGW-based watermarking method that jointly targets functionality preservation and strong watermark embedding. SkillMarker unifies quality-constrained rewriting with signal-oriented candidate search. The former separates essential knowledge from flexible expression to preserve instruction fidelity; the latter explores alternative expressions to obtain a stronger watermark signal under preservation constraints. We release an open-source toolkit that integrates watermark embedding, quality auditing, and detection to support the protection of agent skills. SkillMarker targets ownership verification and leakage tracing in distributed skill ecosystems, where content may be copied in whole or in part, or incorporated into other skills.
hf.titleZh: SkillMarker：一种基于 KGW 的 Agent 技能归属验证水印方法
hf.summaryZh: Agent 技能以明文分发时易被复制与泄漏，而技能归属验证与泄漏溯源机制仍不成熟；结构化、紧凑的技能指令对事实与流程准确性要求极高，直接嵌入水印会损害功能。SkillMarker 把质量约束改写与信号导向的候选搜索结合：前者分离必要知识与可替换表达以保持指令保真，后者在保真约束下搜索能增强水印信号的替代表达。作者开源了集成水印嵌入、质量审计与检测的工具包，面向技能被整体或部分复制、被并入其他技能的分发场景做归属验证与溯源。
hf.reason: LLM 水印用于 Agent 技能溯源，方向擦边且偏工具化

hf.title: A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics
hf.abstract: Monocular world-space human recovery methods excel on current benchmarks, but these rarely include fast camera motion. We introduce the K-Pop stress test, broadcast dance videos that combine fast, large camera motion with dense multi-person choreography. Leading methods produce plausible per-frame meshes on these videos, yet their world-space trajectories drift far from the performers' stage positions. Through a systematic diagnosis, we show that the camera and human estimates each remain self-consistent, and that the drift appears when they are combined at mismatched scales. Each is recovered at its own scale, so a mismatch between the two can turn camera motion into human drift that grows with camera displacement and becomes severe in broadcast dance videos. We derive a closed-form correction that estimates this mismatch and applies one scale to all performers, removing the drift while keeping their relative positions in one shared world frame. It requires no retraining and works with existing backends. Combined with physical constraints, the correction yields stable world-space reconstruction for choreography modeling, scene editing, data generation, and virtual reshooting.
hf.titleZh: 高相机动态下世界坐标系人体恢复的诊断研究
hf.summaryZh: 单目世界坐标系人体恢复在现有 benchmark 上表现良好，但这些 benchmark 普遍缺少快速相机运动。作者提出 K-Pop 压力测试，用同时包含大范围快速相机运动与密集多人编舞的广播舞蹈视频进行评测，发现主流方法逐帧网格看似合理，但世界坐标系轨迹严重偏离舞者的真实舞台位置。诊断表明相机估计与人体估计各自自洽，漂移来自二者以不同尺度组合时的尺度不匹配，且随相机位移增大而加剧。作者给出闭式校正，估计该失配并对所有表演者施加统一尺度，无需重训练即可在现有后端上消除漂移，可用于编舞建模、场景编辑、数据生成与虚拟重拍。
hf.reason: 属 3D 人体/世界坐标重建，与 LLM 高分方向无交集

hf.title: RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models
hf.abstract: Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.
hf.titleZh: RAR:面向时间一致交互式世界模型的速率自适应 rollout
hf.summaryZh: 针对视频交互式世界模型只能以固定时间速率训练与 rollout 的「时间速率耦合」问题——运行时吞吐与学习速率不匹配会导致世界演化变快或变慢，单一速率又在固定上下文窗口下迫使时间粒度与物理时长二选一——提出速率自适应 rollout 框架 RAR。其核心组件 Stride-RoPE 将不同速率采样的隐帧对齐到统一的物理时间坐标，从而支持多速率一致 rollout、未见速率泛化与在线切换速率且无需丢弃历史;同时用多步长视频采样联合学习细粒度动态与长时程演化。在动作控制与相机控制环境中，RAR 在同等训练预算下实现了时间一致的多速率 rollout 与在线速率切换，保持高帧率生成质量并延长物理时程，并可迁移至预训练世界模型且保持感知质量。
hf.reason: 视频世界模型生成侧工作，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 关注面基本无交集

arxiv.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
arxiv.abstract: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting. However, most leading models predict marginal quantiles, leaving the dependence structure of future trajectories unspecified. This distinction matters for trajectory-dependent quantities such as cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing, yet point and marginal scores do not reveal it. To model this dependence, we introduce PathFM, a trajectory-based forecasting model that uses flow matching to generate complete future paths. We further distill the model to one or two steps and share history attention cache across draws. Together, these enable PathFM to generate multiple paths for a single series in roughly the time needed for one query to a quantile model. The distilled sampler also makes it practical to optimize a calibration loss directly. PathFM achieves competitive marginal accuracy on the established forecasting benchmarks fev-bench and TIME. To complement these evaluations, we introduce Forecast Path Score Bench (fps-bench), which augments fev-bench tasks with energy and variogram scores and downstream metrics. PathFM achieves a higher aggregate path score on fps-bench than all evaluated external baselines. Experiments on chaotic systems further show that our flow model sustains long-run variability, while strong baselines rapidly collapse. PathFM makes generative time series forecasting both competitive and practical, enabling diverse downstream applications.
arxiv.titleZh: PathFM：多元轨迹的快速生成式预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对时序基础模型多只预测边际分位数、不刻画未来轨迹依赖结构的问题，PathFM 用 flow matching 生成完整未来路径，并把采样器蒸馏到一两步，同时在多次采样间共享历史注意力缓存，使单条序列生成多条路径的耗时约等于一次分位数模型查询，蒸馏后还可直接优化校准损失。在 fev-bench 与 TIME 上其边际精度具竞争力，新提出的 fps-bench 加入能量与变分函数得分及下游指标，PathFM 的聚合路径得分超过全部外部基线；在混沌系统上它能维持长期变异性，而强基线迅速崩溃。
arxiv.reason: 时序生成式预测，偏离 LLM 关注方向，仅方法层面略相关

arxiv.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
arxiv.abstract: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.
arxiv.titleZh: OmniVerifier-C1:面向规则约束生成式世界建模的分解式分级验证器
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多模态验证器只能给出 True/False 离散判断的问题，把复杂提示或环境规则自动分解为细粒度子问题并逐点打分，输出连续、可解释的评判信号，提升域外多模态评判任务上的泛化。训练上采用解耦 RL 策略，联合优化子问题级二值判断与全局对齐打分，以局部反馈支撑全局连续评分。在文生图场景中分级验证器显著优于二值验证器;在 Maze、Sudoku 等规则约束的生成式世界建模任务上，理论分析表明有真值图像时成对验证比逐点验证更准确，实验也验证了这一结论。
arxiv.reason: 分级验证器与 RL 训练有借鉴价值，但主战场是视觉生成验证

arxiv.title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales.
arxiv.titleZh: 重新思考现代混合专家模型中的路由探索
arxiv.summaryZh: 现代 MoE 普遍同时采用细粒度专家分割与共享专家，但二者构成一个「探索困境」:共享专家降低了 token 表示的多样性，使路由探索不足，而细粒度分割因组合空间急剧扩大反而更需要探索，导致其额外表达能力在实践中难以兑现。为此提出 MirrorMoE，通过按 token 自适应地抑制不必要的专家来缩小探索空间，从而在两种设计之间取得平衡。实验表明该方法在不同模型规模上均能稳定提升性能。
arxiv.reason: MoE 路由机制的结构性分析与改进，命中架构方向

arxiv.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
arxiv.abstract: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.

arxiv.titleZh: FDE-Gym：AI 交付的最后一公里
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 agent benchmark 多针对已明确的任务，而真实客户交付要求前向部署工程师澄清模糊需求、在线上系统中作业并发现未明说约束。FDE-Gym 收录 18 个行业、20 个客户场景的 95 个端到端交付任务，由行业专家从真实项目改编，在含脚本化利益相关者与可修改客户系统的模拟环境中考察 agent 的交互与交付，按客户自身成功指标的提升归一化打分，并对消息、试运行与等待时间计罚。评测 7 家提供商的 13 种模型配置，最佳配置平均得分仅 0.56，只解决 95 个任务中的 14 个；发现未明说约束是主要瓶颈，即便在已获取全部关键事实的 23 个任务上也只有 10 个业务提升达到 0.8。
arxiv.reason: Agent 真实交付场景 benchmark，贴合 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: MLExpert：迈向自主机器学习工程的通用智能体模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向长时程机器学习工程（MLE）中实验反馈滞后、监督信号稀疏的问题，提出自主长程 MLE 优化的后训练方法，并训练出 35B MoE 智能体模型 MLExpert。构建 Kaggle-MLE Factory 生成可执行任务与交互 harness，用层级式 agentic SFT 迁移通用工具使用与代码能力；Windowed Interaction RL（WIRL）将相邻两次实验结果之间的多轮决策视为一个执行窗口并赋予共享的结果奖励，配合异步收集与策略修正实现轨迹结束前的策略更新。在 MLE-Bench Lite 上把基座模型的平均奖牌率从 37.9% 提升到 72.7%，接近 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3 等更大规模前沿模型，并在 NatureBench Lite、agent scaffold 优化与算法优化上体现泛化能力。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 训练 MLE 智能体，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Lean Graph Search for Formal Theorem Proving
arxiv.abstract: Retrieving relevant lemmas is crucial for formal theorem proving, enabling provers to build machine-checkable proofs from established mathematical results. Recent retrieval systems match library declarations to a target theorem or its intermediate proof steps, but make limited use of multi-hop dependencies among declarations. These dependencies can reveal supporting lemmas that are not necessarily lexically similar to the target theorem but recur in proofs of related problems. To this end, we propose LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that constructs a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses it to uncover supporting lemmas through multi-hop dependency chains. Specifically, LeanGraphSearch links each declaration to the premises it depends on, uses a graph-based ranking algorithm to propagate relevance from semantically matched declarations to their dependencies, and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query. Across two mathematical retrieval benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves recall by up to 12% over the strongest baseline, LeanSearch v2, on MathlibQR and increases coverage of complete annotated proof routes on MathlibMPR, covering up to 3.7% of extra groups. More importantly, we evaluate whether these retrieval gains translate into improved end-to-end theorem proving by integrating LeanGraphSearch into an iterative proving loop guided by Lean feedback. Across three theorem proving benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves pass rate at {8, 16, 32} reflection turns by as much as 40% compared to vanilla prover and at most 10% compared to LeanSearch v2, showing higher accuracy-cost efficiency. These findings highlight the value of dependency graph search for theorem proving and motivate further research on structure-aware search for proof discovery.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向形式化定理证明的 Lean 图搜索
arxiv.summaryZh: 形式化定理证明中检索相关引理至关重要，但现有系统主要做词面匹配，未充分利用 Mathlib 声明间的多跳依赖关系。LeanGraphSearch 从 Mathlib 的前向依赖构建图，将每条声明链接到其依赖的前提，用图排序算法把语义匹配声明的相关性传播到其依赖项，再对扩展候选重新排序。在 MathlibQR 上召回率最高提升 12%,MathlibMPR 上完整标注证明路径覆盖率额外提升 3.7 个百分点;接入 Lean 反馈驱动的迭代证明循环后，在 8/16/32 轮反思下通过率较原始证明器最多提升 40%，较 LeanSearch v2 最多提升 10%，展现出更高的准确率—成本效率。
arxiv.reason: 检索增强的形式化定理证明，属 LLM 推理与工具链擦边方向

arxiv.title: Robust Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Treatment Regimes under Model and Measurement Uncertainty
arxiv.abstract: We develop a robust reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning adaptive treatment policies that generalize across patients and remain reliable under errors in the measured biomarker and shifts in the disease dynamics. By modeling the patient as a hidden context, we address generalization and robustness in a unified manner through robust contextual Markov decision processes. Applying our framework to adaptive therapy for metastatic prostate cancer in a simulator calibrated to clinical data, we obtain generalizable and robust policies that substantially outperform the existing adaptive therapy method. In particular, we attain robustness with almost no loss of performance when the biomarker is accurate and the disease evolves as anticipated, and find that the resulting policy Pareto-dominates the existing method across a diverse array of scenarios. Our findings suggest that robust RL holds great promise as a principled methodology for learning reliable adaptive treatment policies.
arxiv.titleZh: 模型与测量不确定性下动态治疗方案的鲁棒强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对测量生物标志物存在误差、疾病动态发生漂移时治疗策略失效的问题，将患者建模为隐上下文，用鲁棒上下文马尔可夫决策过程统一处理泛化与鲁棒性。在按临床数据校准的转移性前列腺癌模拟器上，所得策略在生物标志物准确且病程符合预期时几乎无性能损失，并在多种场景下 Pareto 优于现有自适应疗法。该工作面向医疗自适应治疗决策，属于强化学习在垂直医疗场景的应用。
arxiv.reason: 医疗治疗方案的鲁棒 RL，属生物医药垂直应用，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can often tell when they are being tested. This ability, known as evaluation awareness, can lead models to act more cautiously during safety evaluations than in real use. Existing work has studied evaluation awareness almost entirely in English, although models serve users in many languages. Indic languages are spoken by over a billion people, yet evaluation awareness remains almost entirely unstudied in them. We test four instruction-tuned models from three families in five Indic languages alongside English. A set of cues varies whether the model is told that it is monitored and whether the monitoring is a safety test. Models refuse harmful requests more often when they are told that they are being tested. This increase appears in all four models and all six languages. In Indic languages, refusal of harmful requests rises by 14.4 percentage points on average. The test cue also brings Indic refusal of harmful requests level with English, but raises refusal of benign Indic requests from 6.9% to 11.3%. We release all 47,880 judged responses to support further work. These results suggest that safety evaluations in Indic languages may not reflect how models treat their everyday users.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越英语的评测意识：LLM 在被印度语言测试时行为会不同吗？
arxiv.summaryZh: 已有的评测意识研究几乎只覆盖英语，而模型需服务多语言用户。该工作选取三个家族的四个指令微调模型，在五种印度语言与英语下，通过操纵「是否被告知被监控」「监控是否为安全测试」两类线索考察模型行为。结果显示，被测试提示下所有模型、所有语言拒绝有害请求的比例均上升，印度语言平均上升 14.4 个百分点，使印度语言的拒绝率追平英语；但无害印度语言请求的拒绝率也从 6.9% 升至 11.3%，并公开 47880 条评判响应。这说明印度语言下的安全评测可能无法反映模型对日常用户的真实行为。
arxiv.reason: 评测意识与多语言安全评测可靠性，命中评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: KnowGPO: Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization for Search Agents
arxiv.abstract: Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, KnowGPO decomposes the information required to derive the answer into atomic knowledge conditions, and represents the state of a trajectory at each step by the subset of conditions it has satisfied. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, and the incremental knowledge gain between consecutive steps serves as an environment-grounded process reward. Experiments on Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA show KnowGPO consistently outperforms outcome-only (GRPO) and process-supervision baselines (GiGPO, IGPO) by 3.8 to 4.2 points, with our 8B model rivaling or exceeding most 32B open-source systems.
arxiv.titleZh: KnowGPO:面向搜索智能体的知识分组策略优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 深度搜索智能体要在长程多轮交互中完成知识密集任务，把信用分配给单次搜索决策十分困难:结果奖励 RL 只给出轨迹级单一终局信号，已有过程监督又把信用锚定在表层轨迹状态或模型内部信号，在观测异构、检索上下文长且含噪时不可靠。KnowGPO 改为按轨迹已获取的任务相关知识对齐:把每个查询所需信息分解为原子知识条件，用已满足条件的子集表示每步知识状态，同状态轨迹分组做组内比较，以相邻步的知识增量作为环境锚定的过程奖励。在 Xbench、BrowseComp-ZH 与 GAIA 上超过 GRPO 及 GiGPO、IGPO 基线 3.8 到 4.2 分，8B 模型媲美多数 32B 开源系统。
arxiv.reason: 搜索 Agent 的 Agentic RL 信用分配，组内知识状态分组，命中后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) offer an alternative approach to parallel language generation; however, most existing studies directly use transformer architectures from either causal large language models (LLMs) or Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation, which were not optimized for CDLMs. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on Transformer architectures for CDLMs and introduce Language Diffusion Transformer (LangDiT), combining feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gradient routing and calibration, and confidence-gated training self-conditioning. LangDiT significantly reduces generation perplexity in matched LangFlow comparisons, establishing a new state of the art in continuous language generation across different model formulations. Using LangFlow as a representative CDLM, LangDiT as a plug-and-play backbone leads to a new state-of-the-art model with a generation perplexity (GenPPL) of 21.72 using 1024 NFEs and 44.72 GenPPL using 128 NFEs on the unconditional generation of 1024-token sequences on the OpenWebText dataset. When adapted to Plaid-style CDLM formulations, LangDiT results in a new leading GenPPL of 11.33 using 1024 denoising NFEs, and 27.51 GenPPL using 128 denoising NFEs. These gains are achieved while retaining each model's underlying representation, training objective, and inference sampler, isolating transformer architecture as a fundamental source of improvement. Our study identifies architectural design as an important source of improvement in continuous diffusion language models.
arxiv.titleZh: 为连续扩散语言模型设计 Transformer 架构
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有连续扩散语言模型(CDLM)大多直接沿用因果 LLM 或图像扩散 Transformer 的骨干，未针对扩散语言建模做优化。本文系统研究 CDLM 的 Transformer 设计，提出 LangDiT，组合特征与 query-key 归一化、更宽的噪声条件注入、似然捷径梯度路由与校准、置信度门控的训练自条件等机制。作为即插即用骨干接入 LangFlow 后，OpenWebText 上 1024 token 无条件生成的 GenPPL 降至 21.72(1024 NFEs)与 44.72(128 NFEs);适配 Plaid 式框架进一步达到 11.33 与 27.51，且保持原有表示、训练目标与采样器不变。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型属低分方向，仅架构设计角度擦边

arxiv.title: Twice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.
