arxiv.titleZh: Twice Upon a Time:面向时间序列推理的互补表示
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有时间序列语言模型(TSLM)只向语言模型暴露单一表示，归纳偏置固定。该工作提出互补表示:折线图保留绝对测量值与观测坐标系，归一化延迟嵌入则消除正幅度缩放与偏移、凸显时序结构，两路经独立视觉编码器转为视觉 token，再以多层特征融合接入共享语言模型。基于 Qwen3-VL-8B，双视图将 TSRBench 总体准确率从单折线图的 44.5% 提升到 53.2%，超出最强专用 TSLM 基线 36.7%,TSExam 达 89.9%，多元 ChatTS 对齐数值准确率 86.8%;评测期干预证实两视图不变性互补。
arxiv.reason: 时序 MLLM 表示设计，擦边多模态理解，但偏垂直数据域

arxiv.title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
arxiv.abstract: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea's quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. This teaches the model to steer each new idea away from its predecessors. We show that our trained 8B model achieves higher creative utility (a measure combining quality and diversity) than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on our contamination-free benchmark. In a pilot human study with four experts, our sets are judged as promising as Claude Opus 4.8's and contain marginally more unique ideas. When a coding agent runs proof-of-concept experiments on the ideas, our model's success@k is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8's, so we see that the added diversity does not cost any executability.
arxiv.titleZh: 训练推理模型生成多样化的科学想法
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对文档驱动的科研想法生成中「只优化单个想法质量、忽视多样性」的问题，提出集合级强化学习目标:单次生成 K 张结构化 idea card，整组联合打分，每个想法的质量按其与前面想法的距离加权，让模型主动把新想法推离已有想法。训练的 8B 模型在无污染基准上 creative utility(质量与多样性的组合指标)超过 Claude Opus 4.8 与 GPT-6 Astra;四位专家的人类评测中与后者相当且独特想法略多;编码智能体做概念验证实验时 success@k 也与 Claude Opus 4.8 相当，表明多样性未牺牲可执行性。
arxiv.reason: 集合级 RL 优化科研想法多样性，命中后训练与 AI for Research

arxiv.title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
arxiv.abstract: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT.
arxiv.titleZh: 在去中心化智能体集群中学习自编排
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体系统通常在固定编排结构内训练个体，把能力学习与群体组织割裂。为此提出的MPT(基于市场的后训练)让智能体通过出价表达参与意愿，出价决定谁执行动作并分配局部训练信用，使动作策略与自编排在无中心协调者时联合演化。在具身合成、机器人导航与深度研究任务上，MPT优于单体式后训练，相同动作策略下学到的自编排也胜过其他协调策略;推理时群体规模越大性能越好，智能体掉线时的损失更小。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体自编排与后训练联合学习，Agentic RL方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
arxiv.abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.
arxiv.titleZh: 一支 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体团队通关 Minecraft
arxiv.summaryZh: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体被放入沙盒生存世界，唯一目标是击败末影龙:每个智能体用 Mineflayer 控制一名玩家，通过游戏内聊天与共享记忆协调，角色分工与全部游戏策略均由智能体自行规划、编写并调试程序完成，无人类预设逻辑。在随机生成、Easy 难度的世界中，团队共写出 2,783 个程序，历时 27 小时 14 分钟、死亡 605 次后击杀末影龙，是首个仅依赖标准 Mineflayer 库、不做预探种子与人工专用工具的全自主通关。该结果说明智能体能维持跨数千个依赖步骤、超过一天的连贯计划，对长时程软件工程与多智能体协作任务有直接参照价值。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体长时程自主编程与协作，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习引导LLM智能体与多智能体系统
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM智能体与多智能体系统在执行长程工具调用和协作时容易偏离总体目标（goal drift），既浪费执行资源又导致任务失败。为此提出一个“引导智能体”，在线观测执行上下文，用低成本快路径判断何时介入、用高成本慢路径决定如何介入，把系统拉回正轨。两条路径通过强化学习联合训练，把成对排序目标与GRPO结合，使模型同时具备漂移判断与干预生成能力。在信息检索类任务上，该方法对单智能体与多智能体系统均提升了性能与效率，且学到的引导能力可泛化到域外任务、迁移到未见执行器，并在不重训的情况下支持可控的干预频率。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 加 GRPO 训练引导智能体，直击多智能体目标漂移

arxiv.title: MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support
arxiv.abstract: With people increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, the need to evaluate these tools is becoming more pressing. Recent benchmarks attempt to mimic a realistic setting by simulating multi-turn interactions with synthetic patients and evaluating them with an LLM-as-a-judge. However, the usefulness of these methods is limited because simulated patients can be overly forthcoming and self-reflective, and judgments typically involve opaque Likert scales with unclear practical utility. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MindEval2, an evaluation framework that consists of two components: Mental Health Quality Rubrics (MHQR), for evaluation, and MindSim, for patient simulation. For MHQR, we collaborate with PhD-level psychologists to develop a set of rubrics that break down response quality into explicit operational criteria that are more interpretable and actionable than existing evaluation taxonomies. MindSim, in turn, is an LLM harness that combines carefully-designed patient profiles with tools, enabling more varied, challenging, and realistic interactions than existing baselines. The harness also contains a memory component that is updated between each interaction, enabling MindEval2 to model the longitudinal aspect of mental health. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight models on MindEval2, finding that while frontier models have largely improved on issues related to surface level quality and boundaries, guidance calibration remains the dominant failure mode across all models, accounting for most of the quality gap.
arxiv.comment: 47 pages, 17 figures, 23 tables. Code, prompts, benchmark profiles and annotations: https://github.com/SWORDHealth/mind-eval
arxiv.titleZh: MindEval2:面向心理健康支持的语言模型评估的临床化患者模拟与评分细则
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对AI心理健康支持评测中合成患者过于配合、Likert量表评分不透明的问题，MindEval2提出两个组件:与心理学博士合作开发的「心理健康质量评分细则」(MHQR)，把回复质量拆解为可解释、可操作的显式标准;患者模拟器 MindSim 则用 LLM harness 结合患者画像与工具，并在每轮交互间更新记忆，以刻画心理健康的纵向特征。在18个闭源与开源模型上的评估显示，前沿模型在表层质量与边界处理上已明显改善，但指导校准(guidance calibration)仍是所有模型的主要失败模式，贡献了大部分质量差距。
arxiv.reason: LLM心理健康评测框架，命中评测方法学但属垂直应用

arxiv.title: Grid-Bench: Can LLMs Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?
arxiv.abstract: Spatial instructions describe how to move objects, transform regions, or modify their surroundings. When several operations are applied in sequence, each acts on a configuration shaped by earlier changes. How accurately can large language models (LLMs) predict the resulting spatial state? We introduce Grid-Bench, an executable benchmark in which eight families of operations transform discrete worlds represented as two-, three-, and four-dimensional grids. Given an initial grid, explicit rules, and an event history expressed as text, a model predicts the complete final grid. Reference execution makes every predicted value checkable, supporting comparisons across spatial operations, history lengths, and workloads. Evaluating six LLMs shows that complete-state accuracy falls sharply as histories grow, with substantial divergence among models that perform similarly on single events. Models with similar exact-match accuracy can nevertheless differ substantially in the number of incorrect cells on shared instances. Even over long histories, some models recover many correct changes beyond what copying the initial state would yield. Grid-Bench makes both complete recovery and these differences in returned states directly measurable across a range of spatial conditions.
arxiv.comment: 39 pages, 15 figures, 15 tables, including appendices. Project website: https://grid-bench.github.io/ ; Code: https://github.com/grid-bench/Grid-Bench ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xzx34/Grid-Bench
arxiv.titleZh: Grid-Bench:LLM 能否预测离散世界如何变化?
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对「多条空间指令依次作用后，LLM 能否准确推断最终空间状态」这一问题，构建了可执行基准 Grid-Bench:八类操作在二维、三维、四维离散网格上变换，模型依据初始网格、显式规则与文本形式的事件历史预测完整终态网格，参考执行器让每个预测单元都可校验，便于跨操作类型、历史长度与负载比较。对六个 LLM 的评测显示，随历史变长完整状态准确率急剧下降，单步表现相近的模型在多步场景下出现明显分化;精确匹配率相近的模型在共享实例上的错误单元数差异很大，且长历史下部分模型仍能恢复若干超出「直接复制初始状态」的正确改动。该基准把完整恢复能力与返回状态间的差异变成可直接度量的指标。
arxiv.reason: 可执行空间状态预测基准，评测方法学扎实，与LLM推理擦边

arxiv.title: Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It
arxiv.abstract: Not all facts a language model can recall support further learning equally well. We distinguish active facts, which support generalization beyond their own recall, from inert facts, which can be recalled but do not support such generalization in a given task. We study this distinction by constructing new relations from existing ones. Take the relation that maps a place to its continent (Paris -> Europe) and assign each of its answers an arbitrary new label (Europe -> crab, Asia -> zebra). The new relation then maps Paris -> crab. We fine-tune the model on the new relation for a subset of subjects, without telling it the original relation or the relabeling rule, and test whether it assigns the corresponding labels to held-out subjects that share an answer in the original relation. Having learned Paris -> crab, does it answer Munich -> crab? Across eleven language models and 70 relations, how linearly readable the original relation is in pretrained representations strongly predicts this generalization. Within each model, the two correlate across relations at Pearson r = 0.87 to 0.92. This association persists when controlling, separately and jointly, for the number of fine-tuning subjects and answers, the model's accuracy on the original relation, and how often the subjects occur in pretraining text. It is also robust to re-randomizing the label assignment and fine-tuning seed, and to replacing the animal labels with labels from thirteen other semantic categories. When we map a fine-tuned model's wrong label back to the original answer it was assigned to, Munich -> zebra becomes Munich -> Asia. Answers recovered this way are more often among the linear probe's top answers for the subject than among the pretrained model's own. Whether a new relation generalizes depends less on whether its facts can be recalled than on how readily their shared structure can be read out linearly.
arxiv.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/NightMachinery/active-inert-facts
arxiv.titleZh: 微调前呈线性的知识在微调后能够泛化
arxiv.summaryZh: 区分「活跃事实」与「惰性事实」:前者能支持超出自身回忆的泛化，后者只能被回忆。用已有关系构造新关系(如把 Paris→Europe 重标为 Paris→crab)，仅对部分主语微调，再测共享原答案的留出主语能否得到对应标签。在11个语言模型、70个关系上，原关系在预训练表示中的线性可读性与该泛化能力高度相关，Pearson r 达 0.87–0.92，分别与联合控制微调主语数、答案数、原关系准确率及主语预训练频率后依然成立;把错误标签映射回原答案后恢复的答案，更多落在该主语的线性探针 top 答案中。说明新关系能否泛化更多取决于共享结构能否被线性读出，而非事实本身能否被回忆。
arxiv.reason: 线性探测可预测微调后的泛化，与知识注入和后训练相关

arxiv.title: AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: AI Consilium:一个 LLM 临床多学科第二意见的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 临床第二意见需兼顾事实可靠、临床连贯、可执行与安全的问题，构建了基于 300 例 NEJM-MedQA 已确诊案例的多维基准:110 例用于医生参考评分与 Judge 校准，190 例留出评估。八条单模型流水线在自由与结构化推理条件下生成角色化意见与交互式会诊报告，由医生校准的 LLM Judge 评阅 3040 份报告。模型身份对质量的影响强于回答格式，结构化终稿在八条流水线中七条平均分更高(管理维度 2.740 对 2.436)，完整结构化综合在五项共享标准上均优于单角色意见，GPT-5.6-Sol 各项领先且达成共识轮数最少。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体会诊与 LLM-as-judge 评测方法学有交集，但场景偏医疗垂直应用

arxiv.title: Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. Our results for the first time suggest that random projection can serve as a competitive and practical baseline for privacy-preserving RAG systems.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于随机投影的隐私保护检索增强生成
arxiv.summaryZh: RAG 在引入外部知识库的同时会带来隐私泄露风险，检索数据易被数据抽取攻击还原。该工作对知识库嵌入与查询嵌入施加同一随机投影，在可证明保持查询—条目语义相似度的同时显著削弱数据抽取攻击。在多种 RAG 架构与数据集上，该轻量方法的检索与生成性能优于基于形式化差分隐私(DP)的已有方案，在强攻击模型下的经验隐私性与之相当，表明随机投影可作为隐私保护 RAG 的实用基线。
arxiv.reason: RAG 隐私与随机投影，方法清晰但属增量改进

arxiv.title: Multi-Target Few-Shot Prompting with Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Few-shot prompting is useful when instructions and rewards are hard to specify. One such application is editing by example, where a demonstrated formatting change or API migration may need to be applied across multiple sites. However, such edits often depend on both left and right context, making generation with causal autoregressive models awkward. We therefore introduce multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, where examples guide the infilling of multiple masked regions within a shared canvas. To address the known challenge of reliably following demonstrations in few-shot prompting, we further leverage selective masking of the canvas to derive a likelihood-ratio reward that favors example-supported infills. Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance yielding further gains in several settings.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于扩散语言模型的多目标少样本提示
arxiv.summaryZh: 少样本提示适用于指令与奖励难以明确规定的场景，比如按示例编辑——把演示过的格式变更或 API 迁移应用到多处位置。这类编辑往往同时依赖左右上下文，因果自回归模型生成起来并不顺手，因此改用扩散语言模型，在共享画布上一次性填充多个掩码区域，由示例提供引导。为提升对示例的遵循可靠性，方法对画布做选择性掩码，导出似然比奖励以偏好示例支持的填充结果。在少样本提示基准与软件重构案例研究中，示例提升了填充准确率，奖励引导在若干设置下带来进一步增益。
arxiv.reason: 核心为扩散语言模型，属低分方向，仅少样本提示与代码重构沾边

arxiv.title: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we introduce Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts each weight update to the bottom singular subspace, eliminating changes along the principal directions. SST is optimizer-agnostic and composes well with fine-tuning recipes including SFT and self-distillation. SST combines tight subspace protection, dense gradient estimation, and a simple refresh mechanism, enabling stronger learning than prior orthogonal fine-tuning methods. With these mechanisms, protecting as much as 99\% of the weight subspace substantially improves retention while preserving strong target-task performance. This behavior strengthens with model and data size and nearly eliminates forgetting in the large-model regime. SST also keeps the model close to its base distribution, inducing $2$--$4\times$ less KL drift than the baseline recipes. Overall, SST advances the learning--forgetting Pareto frontier, making it a practical default for fine-tuning pre-trained language models.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向持续学习：用子空间微调缓解遗忘
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 微调中的灾难性遗忘：SFT 的更新集中在权重矩阵的主奇异方向上，因而遗忘严重，而 RL、on-policy 蒸馏等 on-policy 方法避开这些方向、遗忘更少。SST 把每次权重更新限制在底部奇异子空间，彻底消除主方向上的变化，且与优化器无关，可叠加 SFT、自蒸馏等微调配方，其关键机制是紧致子空间保护、稠密梯度估计与简单的刷新机制。在保护高达 99% 权重子空间的情况下仍保持强劲的目标任务性能，遗忘随模型与数据规模增大而减弱，大模型区间近乎消除，KL 漂移相比基线降低 2–4 倍，为预训练语言模型微调提供更优的学习—遗忘 Pareto 前沿。
arxiv.reason: 子空间约束缓解灾难性遗忘，命中后训练与持续学习方向

arxiv.title: CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH surpasses honesty steering in maintaining utility, thanks to a novel choice of utility data.
arxiv.titleZh: 剖析诚实：CATCH——面向可迁移 LLM 诚实性的持续对抗训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对对齐训练后 LLM 仍会输出与知识矛盾或缺乏上下文依据内容的问题，提出持续对抗训练方法 CATCH：以自报告场景构造的数百条目标为数据，把模型拉向诚实回答、推离不诚实回答，同时用特定效用数据维持原有能力。在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-3.6-27B 上训练后，该行为可跨 benchmark 迁移：MASK 压力场景下不诚实下降，Among Us 多智能体博弈中坦白增多，AuditBench 中模型隐藏行为的检出率提升。效果优于 prompting 与监督微调，与当前最优的诚实性激活引导相当，并因效用数据的选取在保持通用能力上更优。
arxiv.reason: 对齐与后训练诚实性方法，多基准可迁移，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: EliteReplay: Preserving Diverse Solutions in RL Post-Training via Quality-Diversity Search
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a common post-training technique to improve the accuracy of LLMs on verifiable tasks. However, such training can narrow the set of solutions the model can produce. Several approaches have attempted to address this behavior-sharpening effect, but they often optimize metrics that do not reflect the diversity of correct solutions. Ideally, we want a model that can produce multiple good solutions, not only a single reliable one. We propose EliteReplay, a post-training recipe that pairs GRPO with an "elite" archive built by quality-diversity search. Before training, we use the frozen base model to collect solutions that span distinct approaches; during training, GRPO is combined with a replay loss on this archive. The result is a post-trained model that improves accuracy while preserving more of the base model's solution diversity. On multiple text-to-SQL tasks, EliteReplay achieves a higher pass@128 than all baselines, producing up to 77% more distinct correct strategies than the strongest baselines. It preserves most of the base model's correct strategies, outperforming existing methods in strategy retention. This diversity translates into practical benefits on ambiguous questions, where EliteReplay covers both interpretations nearly twice as often as the strongest baseline on AmbiQT.
arxiv.titleZh: EliteReplay:通过质量-多样性搜索在RL后训练中保留多样化解法
arxiv.summaryZh: RL后训练能提升LLM在可验证任务上的准确率，却会收窄模型可产生的解法集合，即行为锐化，而现有方法优化的多样性指标往往并不反映正确解法的多样性。EliteReplay在训练前用冻结的基座模型通过质量-多样性搜索收集覆盖不同思路的解法，构建精英存档，训练时将GRPO与在该存档上的replay loss相结合。在多个text-to-SQL任务上，其pass@128超过全部基线，产生的不同正确策略最多比最强基线多77%，并保留了基座模型的大部分正确策略;在歧义问题数据集AmbiQT上，同时覆盖两种解释的频率约为最强基线的两倍。
arxiv.reason: GRPO后训练保留解法多样性，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Improving Environment-Agnostic Coding Agents: The Role of Scaffolding
arxiv.abstract: Stronger language models may increasingly construct useful procedures for themselves, reducing the advantage of developer-supplied scaffolding. We investigate why this advantage persists and whether an environment-agnostic agent can be improved without environment-specific engineering. We evaluate a Codex-based agent in two nearly identical prompt variants on ARC-AGI-3, AGI Maze, and Terminal-Bench. Each variant is deployed with unchanged code, prompts, and general-purpose tools across environments, receiving environment-specific information as input. Changing only an instruction to encourage reporting difficulties and returning control for automatic continuation improves mean scores on both ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze, while Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes. Yet the general agent remains below an ARC-AGI-3-specific reference, including with GPT-5.6-sol. The reference prescribes organization and control rather than supplying new game rules or solutions. To investigate this gap, we transfer reset decisions to a scripted controller that follows a convention already given to the agent. This small change recovers part of the specialized agent's advantage. A complementary AGI Maze experiment shows that additional tutorial experience can reduce performance. Together, these findings highlight the distinction between having information and tools available and using them effectively. Supplied procedures still matter for the models tested here. The performance gains also come with higher token-based cost. The experiments do not separate better use of information and procedures from additional or differently allocated inference. We provide the EnvTraverse framework and an evaluated baseline agent for testing whether further environment-independent changes improve performance in some environments without degrading it in others.
arxiv.titleZh: 改进环境无关的编程智能体：脚手架的作用
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对「模型变强后开发者提供的脚手架是否仍有价值」这一问题，在 ARC-AGI-3、AGI Maze 与 Terminal-Bench 上评估同一个基于 Codex 的智能体：代码、提示与通用工具完全不变，仅以输入形式提供环境特定信息。只改一条指令——鼓励报告困难并把控制权交回以自动续跑——就提升了 ARC-AGI-3 与 AGI Maze 的平均分，Terminal-Bench 只有小幅且好坏参半的变化，但仍低于 ARC-AGI-3 专用参考智能体（即便使用 GPT-5.6-sol）；把 reset 决策交给遵循既有约定的脚本控制器，可挽回部分专用智能体的优势，而 AGI Maze 中额外教程经验反而降低表现，收益也伴随更高的 token 成本。作者由此指出「信息与工具可用」与「有效使用它们」是两回事，并开源 EnvTraverse 框架与基线智能体，供检验更通用的改动能否在部分环境提分且不损害其他环境。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness/脚手架与环境无关性的系统性研究，正命中方向

arxiv.title: Learning Rational Strategies for Temporal Objectives in Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ($\mathsf{PLTL}_f}$). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent's probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile -- if one exists -- such that (i) the designated agent's probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response checking. Our approach operates in a stochastic \emph{Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning} (MARL) environment, where model-free learning algorithms attempt to attain extremal satisfaction probabilities for temporal objectives automatically compiled into reward automata. Our approach is empirically validated using 8 general-sum concurrent stochastic games.
arxiv.titleZh: 多智能体系统中时序目标的理性策略学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对动态未知的随机多智能体系统，研究带概率时序目标(PLTL_f)的理性策略综合:以 Nash 均衡、子博弈完美均衡等解概念约束联合策略剖面，收益取各智能体满足自身时序目标的概率，目标是找到既满足指定智能体概率时序约束、又在所选解概念下稳定的策略剖面。方法给出表格型 Nash-Q 学习的条件收敛保证、同步有限样本置信界下的满足性认证，以及基于近似最佳响应的策略稳定性检验;时序目标自动编译为奖励自动机，在无模型 MARL 环境中学习求解。在 8 个一般和并发随机博弈上完成实证验证。
arxiv.reason: 经典 MARL 博弈论与时序逻辑综合，与 LLM 方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
arxiv.abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH, a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent's latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. LEASH has three layers: (1) initial task uncertainty for early routing, (2) step-level uncertainty for runtime escalation, and, after handoff, (3) a shadow observer for continued oversight of the strong black-box agent. Here, we use latent uncertainty as a fuel for all three layers. Specifically, we compare the weak model's hidden states with those from its past successful and failed trajectories, and a state that looks more like the failures signals higher uncertainty. During weak-agent execution, our uncertainty estimator reuses activations already produced during action generation, so it needs no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training. Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents and outperforms random escalation by 6.55--11.94 points at matched escalation rates. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.
arxiv.titleZh: LEASH:面向计算机使用智能体的不确定性感知弱到强升级与监督
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长程 computer-use 任务中逐步调用前沿模型成本过高、小模型单独执行又易失败的问题，提出免训练框架 LEASH，仅在弱模型隐状态不确定性提示需要时才启用强模型，并在交接后持续监督。其不确定度由弱模型隐状态与历史成功/失败轨迹对比得出，复用动作生成时已产生的激活，无需额外前向或训练专门监控器;三层机制分别对应初期任务路由、运行时步级升级与交接后的 shadow observer 黑盒监督。在 OSWorld 四个模型骨干上，相同升级率下比随机升级高 6.55–11.94 分;Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 以 73.66% 成功率、每任务 $0.4117 匹配 always-on Claude Opus 5 的 72.90%，推理成本降低 19.2%。
arxiv.reason: Agent 升级路由与不确定性监督，成本可控，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.
arxiv.titleZh: Librarian Agents:训练 LLM 策划能预判未来查询的长上下文工作区
arxiv.summaryZh: 长文档上下文的推理仍是 LLM 的难题:常规检索本质是被动响应，复杂跨文档推理会卡在推理时;知识图谱等预计算结构又依赖刚性启发式。该工作让 builder agent 把原始文档改写成由合成文件与引用链接构成的层级文件系统，为下游 answering agent 预先搭好工作区，并将工作区构建形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，用强化学习直接以下游答题准确率为目标优化 builder 策略。结果在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强检索与预计算基线高出 33 个百分点，构建开销可在重复查询间摊销，并在 BRIGHT 上零样本迁移到未见领域，平均准确率提升 31 点。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 训练工作区主动策展，长上下文与 Agent 双命中

arxiv.title: X-RIC: An Agentic RAN-Intelligent Controller Benchmark for Enhancing Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: The O-RAN ALLIANCE introduces architectural flexibility through disaggregation and AI-driven control. While the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) enables centralized optimization, current AI approaches lack reasoning capabilities and explainability. We propose eXplainable RIC (X-RIC), a novel framework integrating agentic AI into O-RAN architectures. X-RIC combines reactive Reinforcement Learning (RL) with strategic agentic reasoning through: (i) automated Behavioral Cloning (BC) using domain heuristics for sample-efficient training, (ii) a Telecom Language Model (TLM), a transformer-based reasoning module providing contextual abstraction and interpretability, and (iii) closed-loop co-adaptation within the Near-RT RIC control loop enabling continuous policy refinement. To ensure deployment readiness, we introduce BARX (Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning for RAN), a domain-specific evaluation framework assessing agentic control across latency, compliance, and determinism metrics. We validate X-RIC on SLA-aware network slicing in simulation and O-RAN-compliant testbed deployments. X-RIC achieves 89% operational cost reduction while maintaining SLA compliance, converging 75% faster with 50% fewer training steps and 46% lower variance.
arxiv.comment: 9 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS), October 21-23, 2026, Hong Kong SAR, China
arxiv.titleZh: X-RIC:面向强化学习增强的智能体化 RAN 智能控制器基准
arxiv.summaryZh: O-RAN 的 RIC 虽支持集中式优化，但现有 AI 方法缺乏推理与可解释性。X-RIC 将智能体推理引入 O-RAN:用领域启发式做自动行为克隆以提升样本效率，以基于 Transformer 的电信语言模型(TLM)提供上下文抽象与可解释性，并在 Near-RT RIC 控制环内闭环协同自适应;同时提出 BARX 基准，从时延、合规与确定性三个维度评估智能体控制。在 SLA 感知的网络切片仿真与 O-RAN 测试床上，该方法降低 89% 运营成本并保持 SLA 合规，收敛快 75%、训练步数少 50%、方差低 46%。
arxiv.reason: 电信 RAN 垂直应用，属网络工程方向，仅与 LLM/RL 擦边

arxiv.title: Baselines and Score Centering in Policy Gradient Estimation
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used approach to post-training large language models. In a typical implementation, learning is off-policy: The policy generating the responses differs from the policy being trained because of training-inference mismatch or policy staleness in asynchronous training. This discrepancy is commonly addressed by importance sampling, whose ratio is usually regularized in practice through truncation, masking, or clipping. Under regularized importance sampling, the importance-weighted policy gradient is no longer invariant to constant shifts in the reward. This invariance is recovered by using the covariance between the reward and the importance-weighted score as the estimand, which coincides with the policy gradient when the ratio is not regularized. This note develops this covariance perspective for both sequence-level and token-level importance sampling. The covariance perspective reveals the roles of the group-mean baseline and score centering in policy gradient estimation. Both perform centering in covariance estimation, but they differ in the mean being subtracted: The group-mean baseline uses a sample mean, whereas score centering uses a population mean. The two lead to distinct unbiased covariance estimators with different variances. Whether both forms of centering should be used simultaneously depends on whether importance sampling is applied at the sequence level or at the token level. With sequence-level importance sampling, score centering adds no benefit once the group-mean baseline is used; with token-level importance sampling, using the group-mean baseline without score centering generally introduces bias when the importance ratio is regularized.
arxiv.titleZh: 策略梯度估计中的基线与分数中心化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对后训练中 off-policy 策略梯度的常见实现:重要性采样经截断、掩码或裁剪正则化后，加权策略梯度不再对奖励的常数平移保持不变，改用奖励与重要性加权 score 的协方差作估计量可恢复该不变性。文章以协方差视角统一分析序列级与 token 级重要性采样，指出 group-mean baseline 与 score centering 都做中心化，但前者减样本均值、后者减总体均值，对应无偏估计量的方差不同。结论:序列级重要性采样下，已有 group-mean baseline 时 score centering 无额外收益;token 级重要性采样下，比率被正则化时只用 group-mean baseline 而不做 score centering 一般会引入偏差。
arxiv.reason: GRPO 组均值基线与重要性采样理论，直击后训练实现细节

arxiv.title: Topology-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Wind-Field Super-Resolution
arxiv.abstract: Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind-field SR models. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence-diagram (PD) distance, and merge-tree (MT) distance favor the CNN, whereas order-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties. Motivated by this disagreement, we fine-tune the pretrained CNN with differentiable topology-inspired auxiliary losses on scalar speed, gradient magnitude, soft high-speed level sets, and local maxima, and with fixed-pair supervision, which constrains predicted values and persistence at ground-truth persistence-pair endpoints located offline with the Topology ToolKit. A loss study of 16 fine-tuning configurations, each compared with a matched standard fine-tuning control that uses only the original reconstruction loss, on a fixed 168-field benchmark (with topology evaluated on a fixed 160 by 160 subregion of each field), shows that, among the scalar-field losses, gradient supervision provides the strongest PD improvement but does not improve mean MT distance, whereas fixed-pair supervision gives the largest and most consistent joint improvement in PD and MT distances. The final objective combines these two signals. Relative to the pretrained CNN, it lowers mean bottleneck, $W_{2,\infty}$, and $W_{2,2}$ distances by 31%, 25%, and 27% (and by 32-35% relative to the control, which on its own worsens all three), lowers all three on 150 of 168 fields, and gains 1.30 dB PSNR, about half the gain of standard fine-tuning. Mean MT distance also improves, but on only 91 of those 150 fields, indicating that PD and MT capture complementary structure.
arxiv.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures; extended version of a poster accepted at TopoInVis Connect 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 拓扑启发的风场超分辨率微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 科学超分辨率模型常用逐点重建损失优化，但科学解读更依赖极值、连通区域与多尺度标量结构。该工作以预训练CNN与GAN风场超分模型刻画这一矛盾:逐点指标与瓶颈持续图距离偏好CNN，而二阶Wasserstein持续图距离偏好更锐利的GAN。据此用可微的拓扑启发辅助损失(梯度幅值、软高速水平集、局部极大值)与固定配对监督微调预训练CNN;在168个固定场基准上，固定配对监督带来最大且最一致的持续图与合并树联合改善，最终目标使平均瓶颈、W2,∞、W2,2距离相对预训练CNN降低31%、25%、27%,150个场三项同时下降，PSNR提升1.30 dB。
arxiv.reason: 风场科学超分，属气象垂直应用，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks
arxiv.abstract: Reducing memory use in large language model (LLM) training is an ongoing challenge. Activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation, while lossy compression changes the stored activations. The reemergence of sparse $\relu$ and $\relu^2$ activations creates a third opportunity: losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. We present BitSparse, a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. Compression and reconstruction run in custom Triton kernels fused into an autograd function, shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. Bfloat16 (BF16) and FP8 activations are supported. Optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. We analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. BitSparse lowers per-token VRAM by 31\% and 30\% Modded-NanoGPT and Nemotron-H respectively, with overheads of no more than 1\% at practical sequence lengths. Additionally, a new preallocated buffer system avoids host synchronization during training when variable size tensors are allocated.
arxiv.titleZh: BitSparse:面向ReLU前馈网络的紧凑激活存储
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM训练中的激活显存瓶颈，在重计算与有损压缩之外提出第三条路:对稀疏ReLU/ReLU²激活做无损压缩。BitSparse用自定义Triton kernel实现GPU常驻的压缩格式，并封装为autograd函数与反向传播融合，支持BF16与FP8，可选符号位打包可把压缩率推到接近理论极限。在Modded-NanoGPT与Nemotron-H上每token显存分别降低31%与30%，实际序列长度下开销不超过1%，并用预分配缓冲区在变长张量场景避免主机同步。适用于长上下文与大规模训练的显存优化。
arxiv.reason: 训练激活无损压缩，直击显存效率方向

arxiv.title: Explore Once, Evaluate Many: Multiple Policy Evaluation for Stochastic Linear Bandits
arxiv.abstract: We study how to evaluate $K$ target policies simultaneously in stochastic contextual bandits with linear reward structure. Given a known $d$-dimensional feature map and reward-free access to policy queries, we propose PRISMA (Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation), an algorithm that estimates every target policy's value to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\!\left( \frac{(L^2S^2+β^2)(1\veeρ^\star)}{\varepsilon^2} \cdot \log(K) \right)$ context draws and reward observations, where $ρ^\star\le d$ is an instance-dependent measure of the difficulty of designing a shared sampling distribution. Here, $L$, $S$, and $β$ bound the feature norm, reward parameter norm, and reward noise, respectively, and the suppressed factors are logarithmic in $K$, $d$, and $1/δ$. Our method combines reward-free planning, a regularized sampling design, and a single ridge regression estimator shared across all target policies. An adaptive doubling procedure selects the regularization scale without knowledge of $ρ^\star$. The guarantees require no numerical lower bound on second-moment eigenvalues and have no explicit dependence on the cardinalities of the context and action spaces. Policy-query costs are accounted for separately, with $K$ queries per shared planning context.
arxiv.titleZh: 一次探索，多次评估:随机线性 Bandit 的多策略评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究随机上下文 Bandit 中同时评估 K 个目标策略的问题:在已知 d 维特征映射、可对策略做无奖励查询的设定下，提出 PRISMA 算法，结合奖励无关规划、正则化采样设计与所有目标策略共享的单个岭回归估计器，用一次数据采集同时给出每个策略价值的 ε 精度估计。样本与奖励观测复杂度为 Õ((L²S²+β²)(1∨ρ*)/ε²·log K)，其中 ρ*≤d 刻画共享采样分布的设计难度，自适应倍增过程无需预知 ρ* 即可选定正则化尺度。保证不依赖二阶矩特征值的数值下界，也不显式依赖上下文与动作空间的基数，适用于需要批量比较大量候选策略的线性 Bandit 评估场景。
arxiv.reason: 纯 Bandit 统计学习理论，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Not X, but When: Diagnosing a Mandarin LLM Writing Tic through Contextual Appropriateness
arxiv.abstract: Recurring expressions in model-written text are often treated as signatures of machine authorship, yet most of them serve legitimate functions. Whether such an expression is a tic depends on whether the model knows when it is called for. This judgment of appropriateness, central to communicative competence, remains largely unexamined for language models. We study it through the Mandarin corrective construction bushi X, ershi Y ("not X, but Y"). Drawing on Gricean pragmatics and corrective negation, we introduce a decision tree that classifies uses as substantive, optional, or defective by testing whether the context makes X a live alternative and whether rejecting X is informative. Five commercial models use the construction 2.5 to 9.2 times as densely as a human reference. Of 307 annotated uses, only 1.30% are defective while 52.8% are optional, that is, correct but unneeded, so models fall short in appropriateness far more often than in correctness. Several reward models favor the construction even over quality-matched variants, an LLM judge favors it even where the context does not license it, and both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization tend to raise its frequency in open-weight models. We hope this work encourages the development of models attentive to the appropriateness of their expressions.
arxiv.titleZh: 不是 X，而是何时:通过语境适切性诊断中文 LLM 的写作口头禅
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 中文写作中反复出现的「不是 X，而是 Y」构式，以 Gricean 语用学与纠正否定为框架，提出决策树，按语境是否使 X 成为可选项、否定 X 是否提供信息量，把用例判为实质性、可选或缺陷。五个商用模型的使用密度是人类参考的 2.5 至 9.2 倍;307 条标注中仅 1.30% 属缺陷，却有 52.8% 属可选，即语法正确但语境不需要，说明适切性短板远大于正确性。多个奖励模型即便面对质量相当的对照文本也偏好该构式，LLM judge 在语境不允许时仍给出偏好，而 SFT 与偏好优化都会提高开源权重模型的构式频率。
arxiv.reason: 奖励模型与 LLM judge 偏差的评测方法学工作，属关注方向但选题偏窄

arxiv.title: Disagreement-Guided Weak-to-Strong Routing
arxiv.abstract: Small language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices and robotic systems to meet cost and latency constraints, yet their limited capabilities can make reliable deployment challenging. Stronger models can provide assistance when needed, but deciding when to route a weak-model response to a stronger model often relies on signals of response correctness. In open-ended and agentic tasks, however, obtaining such signals can require costly ground-truth supervision that is difficult to obtain at scale. We revisit the foundations of weak-to-strong routing and ask whether routing decisions can instead be guided by signals that do not require ground-truth supervision. We first characterize the optimal weak-to-strong routing policy, while allowing for multiple weak-model responses generated through local inference. Building on this characterization, we derive a principled approximation to the optimal routing based on model-to-model comparison. In particular, we introduce a notion of model disagreement that can be measured directly from model-generated responses, without ground-truth supervision. Importantly, the approximation becomes increasingly accurate as the strong model becomes a better proxy for the ground-truth distribution. Across agentic and single-turn tasks, our approach effectively navigates the trade-off between routing cost and response accuracy without ground-truth supervision. Moreover, even when ground-truth correctness signals are available for training, disagreement-based routing can outperform methods trained directly to predict correctness
arxiv.titleZh: 分歧引导的弱到强路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 小模型在边缘与机器人场景中受成本与延迟约束被广泛部署，但能力有限;何时把小模型的回答转交给强模型，通常依赖需要昂贵真值监督的正确性信号，在开放式与 Agent 任务中难以规模化获取。该工作重新刻画了弱到强路由的最优策略，并允许局部推理产生多条弱模型回答，进而在模型间比较的基础上给出最优路由的原则性近似，提出可直接从模型生成回答中度量、无需真值监督的「模型分歧」概念;当强模型越接近真值分布时该近似越准确。在 Agent 与单轮任务上，该方法无需真值监督即可在路由成本与回答准确率之间取得平衡，且在训练时即使可用真值正确性信号，分歧路由仍能超过直接预测正确性的方法。
arxiv.reason: 无监督弱到强路由，分歧信号替代正确性监督，属效率与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Shortcut Sensitivity in Agent-Safety Evaluations
arxiv.abstract: AI agents take actions through tools. Some actions are sensitive, so guards that supervise them must themselves be evaluated reliably. Yet the data used to evaluate a guard can include cues that make labels predictable without measuring the intended safety construct, and those cues can also influence guard decisions. We introduce a three-level shortcut-auditing framework and audit completed LinuxArena trajectories and two TS-Bench-derived step datasets. We distinguish label predictability, observational guard association, and paired decision sensitivity. In LinuxArena, shorter average shell commands strongly predict trajectory labels. In AgentDojo-Traj, exact-tool lookup falls from F_1=.901 with mixed-domain folds to .495 under domain holdout. In AgentHarm-Traj, released TS-Guard F_1 falls from .902 under row weighting to .719 with equal interaction weighting, while balanced accuracy rises. We then test the strongest safe-row marker association in a seven-configuration screen on a frozen 64-step AgentDojo-Traj cohort using repeated, interleaved Haiku calls. Rewriting the <INFORMATION> marker lowers blocking by 8.33 percentage points, while opaque tool aliases raise it by 11.46 points. All unsafe calls remain blocked; the changes concern false positives against inherited labels. Both effects remain nonzero after subtracting the formatting-placebo effect, with exploratory 95% ranges excluding zero. The same edits also change measured accuracy against inherited labels. This provides direct evidence that benchmark representation can materially change a guard's decisions and measured evaluation performance. The Haiku-sized effects do not reproduce in Luna or deterministic Q8 TS-Guard. We recommend domain group holdouts, evaluation-unit metrics, and placebo-controlled paired interventions.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshops TAE (Can We Trust AI Evaluation?) and AIWILD (Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond)
arxiv.titleZh: Agent 安全评测中的捷径敏感性
arxiv.summaryZh: Agent 靠工具行动，监督它的 guard 评测本身可能被数据里的捷径线索带偏。工作提出三级捷径审计框架(标签可预测性、guard 观察性关联、配对决策敏感性)，审计 LinuxArena 与两个 TS-Bench 派生数据集:短平均 shell 命令强预测轨迹标签，精确工具查找 F_1 从 0.901 降至域留出的 0.495,TS-Guard F_1 从行加权 0.902 降至等交互加权 0.719。在冻结 64 步队列的七配置配对干预中，改写 <INFORMATION> 标记使拦截率降 8.33 个百分点，不透明工具别名使其升 11.46 个百分点，变化均在误报。建议域分组留出、按评估单元计指标与安慰剂对照。
arxiv.reason: Agent 安全评测捷径审计，命中 Agent 与评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: Query-Efficient Rejection Sampling for Parallel Masked Diffusion
arxiv.abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) accelerate generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel, but sampling these tokens independently ignores their correlations and biases the output. Anari et al. (2026) corrected this bias with rejection sampling, decomposing the log acceptance probability into a sum of token-level terms, but the evaluation requires one score query per unmasked token. We propose the Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS), which provides an estimate of the log acceptance probability from a single randomly sampled increment at the cost of one query. SIRS then converts a Poisson number of clipped estimates into accept/reject decisions through a Bernoulli factory adapted from Chen et al. (2026). Since each query returns the conditionals of all remaining tokens in the block, we further Rao-Blackwellize each increment by averaging over these tokens at no extra cost, thereby reducing clipping. We show that the KL-divergence between the data distribution and the SIRS output is bounded by a clipping term plus the model's training error. With exact scores, parallel decoding pays the full within-block dependence, whereas SIRS pays only the part beyond the clipping range.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向并行掩码扩散模型的查询高效拒绝采样
arxiv.summaryZh: 掩码扩散模型通过并行解掩多个 token 来加速生成，但独立采样忽略 token 间相关性，使输出产生偏差。Anari 等(2026)用拒绝采样修正该偏差，把 log 接受概率分解为 token 级项之和，代价是每个解掩 token 需一次打分查询。本文提出 Single-Increment Rejection Sampler(SIRS)，仅用一次随机采样的增量、一次查询即可估计 log 接受概率，并借助改编自 Chen 等(2026)的 Bernoulli factory 把泊松数量的截断估计转成接受/拒绝决策;由于每次查询会返回 block 内其余 token 的条件分布，进一步对其做 Rao-Blackwell 化以在零额外开销下减轻截断。理论证明 SIRS 输出与数据分布的 KL 散度上界为截断项加模型训练误差，且并行解码只需付出超出截断范围的那部分 block 内依赖代价。
arxiv.reason: 掩码扩散语言模型的采样改进，属明确低分方向

arxiv.title: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation consolidates specialist models into one student at the price of rollouts, teacher passes and gradient steps for every teacher. We show that the consolidation does not need training: with forward passes only, the capabilities of separately tuned specialists can be aggregated into one model that is, on average, more accurate than either specialist alone. When specialists share a base model, distillation has an exact layer-wise solution: each linear layer of the fused model must reproduce every specialist's output on the inputs that specialist receives while reading its own answers, a least-squares problem whose solution needs only the second moments of those inputs. One forward pass over a few hundred rollouts provides them. We call this training-free on-policy distillation (\method). What the rollouts contain matters more than the solver: answers truncated in repetition loops are few among a mathematics specialist's rollouts but carry a large share of their tokens, and removing them lifts the fused model on AIME25 from task arithmetic's level to the specialist's at matched precision. On Olmo~3 7B, a few GPU-hours of forward computation per specialist yield a generalist that keeps most of each specialist's gain on each of seven mathematics and code benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 免训练的同策略蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 把多个专家模型合并成一个学生模型通常要付出rollout、教师前向与梯度更新的代价。该方法指出:当专家共享同一基座时，蒸馏存在精确的逐层最小二乘解——每层只需复现专家在其自身回答所对应输入上的输出，所需仅为这些输入的二阶矩，几百条rollout的一次前向即可估计，无需任何训练。rollout的构成比求解器更关键:剔除陷入重复循环的截断答案后，融合模型在AIME25上从task arithmetic水平提升到专家水平。在Olmo 3 7B上，每个专家几GPU小时的前向计算即得到一个通才模型，在七个数学与代码基准上保留各专家的大部分增益。
arxiv.reason: on-policy蒸馏免训练融合，直击后训练蒸馏方向，方法新颖

arxiv.title: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
arxiv.abstract: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.
arxiv.titleZh: OS-Helix:在原生计算机使用智能体中统一 GUI 交互与代码执行
arxiv.summaryZh: 真实桌面自动化既非纯视觉也非纯编程:现有 GUI 智能体在提示层叠加代码工具反而变差，说明 GUI/代码路由需经训练内化。OS-Helix 把 GUI 动作与代码执行统一进单一动作空间，用「应用—产物组合」构造可执行 Ubuntu 状态，并以指令/评估器解耦的生成管线产出环境接地、与解法模态无关的可验证任务;策略先由混合数据 SFT 冷启动，再在真实桌面环境做在线 RL，其 Step-balanced GSPO 按动作步而非原始 token 聚合重要性权重，避免长代码动作主导异构动作优化。在 OSWorld-Verified 上，27B 与 35B-A3B 较匹配的 Qwen3.5 混合基线分别提升 35.0% 与 33.7%,27B-RL 再提升 42.9% 至 66.44% 成功率，并在 WindowsAgentArena 上显示跨平台迁移。
arxiv.reason: 计算机使用智能体，统一 GUI/代码动作空间加在线 RL，正中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: GNN-Guided Local Refinement for Efficient Layout Decomposition with DSA-MP
arxiv.abstract: Multiple patterning lithography (MPL) has been widely used to improve lithography resolution in advanced nodes, but it faces cost limits as feature sizes shrink. Directed self-assembly (DSA) offers a cost-effective complement, extending the resolution of optical lithography to sub-10 nm and beyond. Integrating DSA into MPL (DSA-MP) further enhances the resolution of contact/via patterning. Nevertheless, growing design complexity exposes the limits of existing decomposition methods, which struggle to balance solution quality and runtime, and neglect edge-to-edge spacing constraints of DSA templates, compromising manufacturability. To address these issues, we introduce a new conflict graph model capturing the previously overlooked constraints and develop a local refinement strategy powered by the graph neural network, enabling efficient and scalable layout decomposition. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves higher solution quality with faster convergence than state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining robustness across layout scales, design styles, technology nodes, and varying mask counts.
arxiv.comment: 9 pages. Accepted at the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: GNN 引导的局部精修用于 DSA-MP 的高效版图分解
arxiv.summaryZh: 在先进节点中，把定向自组装与多重曝光光刻结合(DSA-MP)可将接触孔/通孔图形分辨率推进到 10 纳米以下，但既有版图分解方法难以兼顾解质量与运行时间，且忽略 DSA 模板的边到边间距约束，损害可制造性。该工作建立新的冲突图模型以刻画这一被忽视的约束，并用图神经网络驱动局部精修，实现高效且可扩展的版图分解。实验表明其解质量高于当前最优方法、收敛更快，并在不同版图规模、设计风格、工艺节点与掩模数下保持稳健。
arxiv.reason: EDA 版图分解，仅借 GNN 做优化，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Generalization Guarantees of Randomized Block Coordinate Descent for Nonconvex Learning
arxiv.abstract: Randomized block coordinate descent (RBCD) is a popular optimization algorithm for many large-scale machine learning problems. The existing theoretical analysis of RBCD mainly focuses on its convergence behavior from an optimization perspective, while its generalization behavior remains less understood for nonconvex problems. In this paper, we establish high-probability generalization guarantees for RBCD with nonconvex objectives. In the general nonconvex setting, we derive bounds on the gradients of both empirical and population risks, requiring only standard smoothness assumptions. With polynomially decaying step sizes, we tune the iteration number to balance optimization and generalization, thereby quantifying how early stopping leads to the optimal convergence rate for the population gradients. In the gradient-dominated setting, we provide bounds in terms of functional suboptimality, which nearly match the optimistic rates in convex and low-noise settings. Finally, we develop dimension-independent bounds for loss functions of a specific structure, making the generalization guarantees applicable to high-dimensional problems.
arxiv.titleZh: 随机分块坐标下降在非凸学习中的泛化保证
arxiv.summaryZh: 随机分块坐标下降(RBCD)是求解大规模机器学习问题的常用优化算法，但已有理论多关注其优化收敛性，非凸目标下的泛化行为缺乏刻画。该工作在高概率意义下建立了RBCD的泛化保证:一般非凸情形仅需标准光滑性假设，即可给出经验风险与总体风险梯度范数的界;采用多项式衰减步长并调节迭代次数以平衡优化与泛化，量化了早停如何使总体梯度达到最优收敛率，在梯度占优设定下以函数次优性给出的界几乎匹配凸与低噪声情形下的乐观速率，并对特定结构损失给出与维度无关的界，使结论可用于高维问题。
arxiv.reason: 非凸优化泛化理论，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
arxiv.abstract: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越下游问答:重新思考如何评估 Agent 记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 Agent 记忆评测以下游问答准确率作为记忆质量的代理，混淆了记忆正确性与检索、生成质量，既产生正确答案掩盖记忆损坏的假阳性，也产生检索失败冤枉正确记忆的假阴性。FEB-30 用范式反转构建:由已知事实轨迹反向生成文档，得到无需人工标注的确定性真值，覆盖 6 个诊断类别、3 个难度级别的 30 条轨迹，规定事实在文档、邮件、对话中的演化，可在每次摄入后直接检查记忆存储。在代表性记忆系统上，内在与外在评测平均相差 16 个百分点，44% 的轨迹超过显著分歧阈值;系统对 create、update、reinforce、supersede 四类记忆操作的分类正确率仅 20%，该失效在外在评测中完全不可见。基准、生成管线与评分框架已公开，支持 Agent 记忆系统的可复现评测。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆评测方法学，直击 QA 代理指标的系统性缺陷

arxiv.title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing
arxiv.abstract: External-memory systems extend language-model applications beyond a context window, but their quality depends critically on the model executing the write path: deciding what to retain, how precisely to represent it, and how new evidence should update persistent state. Existing frameworks typically place a general-purpose large language model behind framework-specific prompts. This raises serving cost, and a writer specialized for one protocol does not transfer directly to another; a unified model that can operate across established memory frameworks remains largely unexplored. We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory. Memory On-Policy Distillation teaches framework-specific write protocols on student-generated states; Memory RL then optimizes downstream answerability using dense per-chunk probes, attributed cross-chunk rewards, over-storage controls, and chunk-level GRPO. Carrying policy-written banks across windows keeps training aligned with deployment. On fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on all four evaluated harnesses, including held-out EverMemOS, with a 55.49% macro average versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5.
arxiv.titleZh: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B：面向长期记忆写入的归因强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 外部记忆系统的质量取决于执行写入路径的模型：保留什么、如何精确表示、新证据如何更新持久状态。现有框架多用通用大模型配框架专用提示，成本高且难以跨协议迁移。Hy-Memory-30B-A3B 是跨 Mem0、MemOS 与 Hy-Memory 训练的紧凑写入模型：Memory On-Policy Distillation 在学生自生成状态上教框架专属写入协议，Memory RL 以逐块稠密探测、跨块归因奖励、过量存储控制与块级 GRPO 优化下游可答性，并跨窗口携带策略写入的记忆库以对齐训练与部署。在固定 20% 基准子集上，它于四个 harness（含留出的 EverMemOS）全部第一，宏平均 55.49%，高于 Claude Opus 5 的 54.62%。
arxiv.reason: 记忆写入的 RL 后训练，GRPO 与 on-policy 蒸馏结合，直接命中

arxiv.title: HTN-Orchestrate: A Hierarchical Task Network Framework for Multi-Agent Orchestration
arxiv.abstract: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under \textbf{AND} semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.
arxiv.titleZh: HTN-Orchestrate:用于多智能体编排的分层任务网络框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体处理复杂任务时需同时协调局部子任务执行与全局规划:动态调度灵活却不显式建模子任务层级与依赖，预定义工作流有结构但把分解固定在执行之前。HTN-Orchestrate 用分层任务网络把两类职责拆成两层:Planner 维护子任务层级与依赖，把分解推迟到前置结果可用之时;局部 Orchestrator 调度 worker 执行叶子子任务，结果按 AND 语义向上回传，当前分解无法解决任务时依据累积发现重建任务网络。在网页研究、科学推理与研究流程等五个基准上，同基础模型下优于 ReAct、Agent Team 与 DeepSeek Harness,BrowseComp 准确率 89.73%、SUPERChem 73.44%，分别高出 Agent Team 2.45 与 4.69 个百分点。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体编排与分层任务规划，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
arxiv.abstract: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.
arxiv.titleZh: AutoSFT：面向监督微调自动化数据研究的智能体系统
arxiv.summaryZh: 监督微调的数据工程包含调整比例、删减、修复、替换、合成等多类操作，现有自动化系统却只让智能体从固定池选行或调用生成器。论文设计覆盖这些操作的数据动作空间，并构建多智能体系统 AutoSFT：meta agent 分离执行与分析、从独立角度收集提案，数据池无法覆盖时调用合成子智能体，比较中固定模型、训练器与预算。逐组件加入均有效：执行器使上下文损失减半，分析子智能体将最优 IFEval 提升 +6.5，合成再贡献 +3.4 IFEval 与 +2.9 IFBench；迁移到代码任务时分析较不改进的单智能体提升 +3.7 MBPP+。每轮均从基座重训，组件效果可单独归因。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体自动化 SFT 数据研究，命中后训练与 Agent 交叉方向

arxiv.title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine
arxiv.abstract: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR). We formulate Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) to retain token-specific baselines while applying decay across interaction turns. Family Dense Reward (FDR) calibrates semantic progress across task families; Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) separates strict success from bounded partial credit. A Warm-up Critic Model, recursive critic handoff, and stage-specific learning rates coordinate the two refinement phases. The five-stage sequence from Qwen3.8-27B base model through RSR-1, RPR-1, RSR-2, and RPR-2 yields Terminal-RSI-27B: 19.84% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 16.95% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 79.00% on Terminal-Bench Hard. On LHTB, process reward rises from 0.21 to 0.37 and strict completion from 0/46 to 5/46; SWR100 success doubles from 3.00% to 6.00%. By recursively coupling verified trajectory rewriting with critic-inheriting policy refinement, each retained stage consolidates discovered behaviors and progressively advances the agent from partial local repairs to strict terminal verification.
arxiv.titleZh: Terminal-RSI:通过递归自我重写与策略精炼实现递归自我改进的终端智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 终端智能体难以把验证器结果转化为有效策略更新，也难把局部修复推进为完整任务解决。方法交替进行验证轨迹的递归自我重写(RSR)与继承 critic 的递归策略精炼(RPR)，并用 TB-GAE 在交互回合间做衰减同时保留 token 级 baseline，以 Family Dense Reward 校准跨任务族语义进展、Success-Prioritized Reward 区分严格成功与有界部分奖励。Qwen3.8-27B 经五阶段训练得到 Terminal-RSI-27B:Terminal-Bench 2.1 达 86.52%、4.0 达 19.84%、Hard 达 79.00%;LHTB 过程奖励由 0.21 升至 0.37，严格完成由 0/46 升至 5/46,SWR100 成功率由 3.00% 翻倍至 6.00%。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 与递归自我改进闭环，机制与多榜单结果扎实

arxiv.title: Change the Number, Change the Answer: Assessing Rating Scale Sensitivity in LLM-Based Text Scoring
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in computational social science to assign scalar scores to social and psychological constructs. However, studies use different rating scales, and whether their scores remain comparable across scale designs is understudied. To address this gap, we define and systematically investigate scale sensitivity, the variation in LLM-generated scores caused by rating scale design. We distinguish numerical sensitivity, changes in normalized scores, from semantic sensitivity, changes in score interpretation. To assess both, our experimental design crosses 2 formats (continuous vs. ordinal), 4 ranges (3, 5, 11, and 21 points), and 2 signs (signed vs. unsigned) across 3 tasks (political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity), 2 prompting strategies (zero-shot and rubric-based), and 5 LLMs. We find that changing one design element shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 on average and changes the category of roughly 20% of texts. Sensitivity is greatest for toxicity, the only unipolar construct examined. Also, rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity compared with zero-shot prompting. We provide practical guidance for designing more reliable LLM-based text scoring and highlight the need for robustness checks across alternative scales.
arxiv.titleZh: 改变数字，改变答案:评估基于 LLM 的文本评分中的评分量表敏感性
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 常被用于计算社会科学中给社会与心理构念打标量分，但不同研究使用的评分量表不同，分数是否跨量表可比缺乏研究。该工作定义并系统考察量表敏感性，区分数值敏感性(归一化分数变化)与语义敏感性(分数解释变化)，以 2 种格式、4 种量程(3/5/11/21 点)、2 种符号交叉，覆盖政治倾向、情感、毒性 3 个任务、zero-shot 与 rubric 两种提示及 5 个 LLM。结果发现只改一个设计要素即平均使归一化分数偏移约 0.10，约 20% 文本的类别发生改变;单极构念毒性最敏感，rubric 提示并未降低敏感性。这为可靠设计 LLM 文本评分与跨量表稳健性检验提供了实践指引。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge 评估可靠性研究，直接命中评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training
arxiv.abstract: Lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training, but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. We introduce Losslessly Compressed Tensors (LCT), a GPU execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. LCT exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights, activations and optimizer states. Highly optimized GPU kernels implement Huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead, essential for training. Our analysis characterizes LCT's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. LCT achieves a compression ratio of up to $1.455\times$, and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. On a 162M-parameter NanoGPT, LCT reduces memory usage by $24.6\%$ for a $7.2\%$ step-time increase. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, LCT saves up to $23.8\%$ of peak memory, enabling a $3.5\times$ larger context length in training on the same GPU.
arxiv.titleZh: LCT:面向训练的无损压缩张量与 GPU 友好执行
arxiv.summaryZh: 训练中张量需反复编码解码，常规无损压缩难以适用。LCT 利用浮点数据的固有冗余，以预计算码本的 Huffman 编码配合高度优化的 GPU 内核，对权重、激活和优化器状态做低开销的无损压缩，并分析了其存储代价与对数值幅度漂移的适应性。在 162M 参数的 NanoGPT 上，压缩比最高达 1.455 倍，显存降低 24.6%，单步耗时仅增加 7.2%;微调 Qwen3-4B 时峰值显存最多节省 23.8%，同卡可支持 3.5 倍更长的上下文。该工作把无损压缩做成训练时可用的显存优化手段，适用于长上下文与大模型微调场景。
arxiv.reason: 训练显存优化系统工作，GPU 内核扎实，契合系统与效率方向

arxiv.title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.
arxiv.titleZh: Mosaic：多会话智能体强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有智能体强化学习多假设单会话轨迹，而上下文压缩、子智能体分叉等做法会产出跨多个会话的轨迹，训练假设与推理时执行不一致。Mosaic 将问题形式化为多会话智能体 RL，采用无 critic 的分层优化：轨迹层把会话使用信号纳入优势估计，会话层按估计的边际贡献重塑各会话优势。在 BrowseComp 上用 Qwen3.5-4B 实验，该方法在上下文压缩与子智能体分叉两种场景均优于将轨迹级优势广播到所有会话的基线，且平均消耗会话数更少，会话利用率与分配均有改善。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 新设定＋分层优势优化，直击多会话训练痛点

arxiv.title: Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics
arxiv.abstract: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the model's output. Its coefficients attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, its lexical basis steers a prediction while sparing other tokens, and its confident readings would let an early exit skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers, where lenses skip almost none. In this way, lexical reference frames make every hidden state of the model readable, attributable and steerable.
arxiv.titleZh: 词汇参考框架:以原生语义解读语言模型残差流
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有的 lens 方法为每层固定方向，或把隐状态当作点云处理，都无法按模型自身的方式读取状态。词汇参考框架(LexFrame)用模型自身的剩余层读取隐状态:位置之间施加指定轮数的注意力，其余位置以典型注意力输出近似，且不拟合模型输出。一阶版本 LexFrame[1] 在 SmolLM3-3B 与 OLMo3-7B 的中层相干度达 0.97(固定方向 lens 上限仅 0.30/0.35)，读数与模型输出相差 0.16 nats;其系数归因比 attribution patching 更忠实，词基可调控单个预测而不波及其他 token，置信读数支持早退跳过 0.45/0.42 的层。该框架让模型的每个隐状态可读、可归因、可调控。
arxiv.reason: 残差流可解释性新方法，含早退与激活调控，属LLM分析方向
